items.title: 銀行甩賣AI資料中心債務！ING、法興尋求出售8億美元貸款、甲骨文3大項目遭波及
paras: 隨著銀行業日益警惕對人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的集中曝險，部分金融機構開始出售相關貸款，降低資產負債表風險。荷蘭ING銀行與法國興業銀行近期合計尋求出售最多8億美元的資料中心債務，涉及多個與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 相關的建設項目，顯示銀行業正逐步釋出AI投資熱潮累積的信用風險。
根據《金融時報》週二（17日）報導，知情人士透露，相關貸款出售行動已持續數月，但美國期中選舉後，民主黨大勝加深市場對美國資料中心監管可能收緊的疑慮，促使銀行加快在年底前整理資產負債表。
此外，英國央行與歐洲央行也相繼啟動對銀行資料中心貸款曝險的審查，進一步增加金融機構的監管壓力。
從貸款報價來看，部分資產仍高於面額的90美分，顯示整體信用品質尚未出現明顯惡化。不過，涉及美國新墨西哥州、因電力供應受阻而面臨延誤的資料中心項目，貸款預估成交價格可能降至面額的85美分左右，反映個別建設計畫已出現實質風險。

ING出售5億美元貸款　法興尋求出清3億美元債務

知情人士表示，ING銀行目前拍賣的貸款規模約5億美元，借款方包括資料中心營運商CyrusOne(CONE-US) 、EdgeConnex及Vantage Data Centres，以及甲骨文在新墨西哥州支持的Project Jupiter。
其中，Project Jupiter目前因電力許可證審批延誤面臨進度問題，甲骨文已針對此事發出不可抗力通知。
法國興業銀行則尋求出售約3億美元的專案融資債務，涉及甲骨文在威斯康辛州的Project Lighthouse，以及德州的Project Frontier。
Project Jupiter、Project Lighthouse以及Project Frontier去年合計向數十家銀行籌集超過560億美元的建設債務。
貸款定價方面，威斯康辛州及德州項目的相關貸款報價仍高於面額90美分。知情人士表示，這波出售主要是投資組合管理操作，並非銀行急於避開信用品質惡化的資產。
相較之下，新墨西哥州項目的貸款預估成交價格約為面額85美分，顯示電力許可延誤已為該項目帶來額外不確定性。

AI融資曝險過度集中　銀行尋求降低風險

知情人士指出，銀行業對AI資料中心債務的疑慮已累積數月，主要問題在於金融機構對少數大型科技公司及尖端AI實驗室的曝險過度集中。
Nuveen全球能源基礎設施信貸主管Don Dimitrievich指出，AI基礎設施所需的資本規模，以任何標準衡量都已創下歷史紀錄，甚至超出傳統資金來源的承受能力。他表示，許多金融機構的風險長已明確要求縮減相關投資組合。
Dimitrievich也指出，近期貸款出售活動提供了較有利的融資條件與更具吸引力的報酬，原因包括部分貸款機構重新評估風險，以及監管資本限制。
律師事務所Linklaters紐約結構性融資合夥人David Lucking表示，銀行持有這類債務的資本效率較低，無論是資本要求、風險限額或內部資產負債表管理，都促使銀行尋找其他方式，以便在控制風險的同時繼續放貸。
除了直接出售貸款，銀行也開始透過信用保險及風險移轉交易管理曝險，並愈來愈常採用144A架構，讓債務能出售給更廣泛的機構投資人。
144A債券是依照美國《1933年證券法》第144A條發行的私募債券，允許發行人向合格機構投資人進行私募，不必經過美國證券交易委員會（SEC）繁複的公開註冊程序。
知情人士透露，Anthropic規模630億美元的債務融資方案，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 為購買AI晶片安排的400億美元融資，預計都將在未來幾個月進入144A債券市場交易。
值得注意的是，部分主要貸款機構已退出Anthropic的融資交易，原因正是擔憂對該AI實驗室的曝險過度集中，反映銀行業對AI相關融資的風險控管正在收緊。

保密條款增加避險難度　英歐監管機構同步調查

除了降低貸款曝險，銀行也面臨另一項風險管理難題。部分資料中心貸款合約設有保密條款，禁止貸款機構參與需要共享貸款資訊的第三方交易，包括信用違約交換（CDS）及合成風險移轉工具，使銀行難以透過一般衍生性金融商品對沖相關風險。
Lucking表示，如果這類限制在市場上愈來愈普遍，將為金融機構帶來相當大的問題。
與此同時，歐洲監管機構也正加強對資料中心融資的審查。知情人士透露，英國央行正向英國各銀行索取資料中心項目貸款的詳細資訊，作為例行監管工作的一部分。
歐洲央行則已啟動監管審查，評估歐元區銀行對資料中心融資的曝險程度及風險管理方式，相關計畫最早於10月底與銀行高層的會議中討論。

items.title: 黃仁勳打破沉默！認了犯錯、願回任輝達 決定權交董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Breaks Silence, Acknowledges Mistakes and Offers to Return as Nvidia CEO if Board Approves
paras: 綜合外媒周二(17日)報導，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳離任後首次發布公開聲明，表態若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，他願意回任執行長。他也承認個人生活犯下嚴重錯誤，承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。
黃仁勳表示，離任後收到許多員工、投資人、合作夥伴及客戶呼籲他回任的聲音。
他說：「如果董事會認為，我的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，我將很榮幸回應這些呼聲，重新擔任執行長。」
對於引發離任的風波，黃仁勳坦言，自己未能達到輝達對所有人的要求，並在個人生活中犯下嚴重錯誤。
他說：「我為董事會帶來了問題，對此深感懊悔。我完全承擔自己的錯誤，並承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。」
黃仁勳上周因婚外情風波辭職，結束33年的執行長任期。輝達已委託 Wachtell Lipton 律師事務所，調查他的行為是否危及國家安全或公司機密，包括他與疑涉中國情報活動的黃樂(Alice Huang)之間的關係。
呼籲黃仁勳回任的網路連署已獲逾18萬人支持，馬斯克等科技業人士也加入聲援。美國總統川普周一表示，不反對黃仁勳重新擔任輝達執行長，並認為他已「學到很大的教訓」。
《華爾街日報》另披露，輝達開發者技術主管 Nader Khalil 周一致函董事長瓊斯(Harvey Jones)，呼籲讓黃仁勳回歸。他在信中表示，相信公司終有一天能找到接班人，但不能倉促進行交接，未來幾年的關鍵時期仍需要黃仁勳領導。
不過，《CNBC》與《華爾街日報》均報導，董事會並未考慮讓黃仁勳回任。輝達董事會上周五表示，正挑選協助尋找新執行長的人才招募公司，並於周二宣布成立新委員會，監督國家安全政策與出口管制遵循情況。

黃仁勳聲明全文


過去一周，朋友、業界同仁，以及素未謀面的人們給予的關愛與支持，讓我深受感動。感謝每一位善待我和家人的人，這對我意義重大。
我在53年前來到美國，成為美國公民，是我人生中最珍貴的禮物之一，也是最引以為傲的時刻之一。輝達是我畢生的心血。能與同事們一起，將它打造為今天這樣的公司，是我的榮幸。只有在美國，才有可能誕生像輝達這樣的公司。我愛我們的國家，也愛輝達。
我未能達到輝達對每一個人的要求，也在個人生活中犯下了嚴重錯誤。我為董事會帶來了問題，對此深感懊悔。我完全承擔自己的錯誤，並承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。
自從離任以來，我看到輝達員工、投資人、合作夥伴與客戶，紛紛呼籲我回任執行長。在公司面對複雜的技術、市場、競爭與地緣政治局勢之際，許多人仍持續直接與我聯繫。輝達是一家一個世代才可能出現一次的公司。如果董事會認為，我的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，我將很榮幸回應這些呼聲，重新擔任執行長。
再次感謝所有向我表達祝福的人。你們的支持，讓我深感謙卑。
致我的家人：我愛你們，我會用餘生努力，讓自己值得你們的愛。
paras_en: Comprehensive foreign media reports on Tuesday (the 17th) said that Jensen Huang, former CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), issued his first public statement since stepping down, indicating that he would be willing to resume the CEO role if the board believes his return serves the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, and he also admitted serious personal mistakes and pledged to cooperate with an independent board investigation.
Huang said that after his departure he received many calls from employees, investors, partners and customers urging him to return.

He said: “If the board believes my return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, I would be honored to answer those calls and resume the CEO position.”
Regarding the controversy that led to his resignation, Huang candidly admitted that he failed to meet Nvidia’s expectations of everyone and made serious personal errors.
He said: “I have caused problems for the board and deeply regret it. I fully own my mistakes and commit to cooperating with the board’s independent investigation.”

Huang resigned last week amid an extramarital affair scandal, ending a 33‑year tenure as CEO. Nvidia has hired the law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate whether his conduct jeopardized national security or company secrets, including his relationship with Alice Huang, who is suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence activities.

A petition calling for Huang’s return has gathered over 180,000 signatures, with tech figures such as Elon Musk joining the support. Former President Donald Trump said on Monday he does not oppose Huang resuming the Nvidia CEO role and believes Huang has “learned a big lesson.”

The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia’s senior developer technology officer Nader Khalil sent a letter to chairman Harvey Jones on Monday urging Huang’s comeback, stating he believes the company will eventually find a successor but cannot rush the transition and that the critical coming years still require Huang’s leadership.

However, both CNBC and the Wall Street Journal reported that the board is not considering Huang’s return. Nvidia’s board said last Friday it is selecting a talent‑search firm to help find a new CEO and announced on Tuesday the creation of a new committee to oversee national‑security policy and export‑control compliance.

Full text of Huang’s statement

Over the past week, the care and support from friends, industry colleagues and even strangers have moved me deeply. I thank everyone who has treated my family and me kindly; it means a great deal to me.

I came to the United States 53 years ago and became a citizen – one of the most precious gifts of my life and a source of great pride. Nvidia is the work of my whole life. It has been an honor to build it with my colleagues into the company it is today. Only in America could a company like Nvidia be born. I love our country and I love Nvidia.

I failed to meet Nvidia’s expectations of every individual and made serious personal mistakes. I caused problems for the board and deeply regret it. I fully own my mistakes and commit to cooperating with the board’s independent investigation.

Since stepping down, I have heard Nvidia employees, investors, partners and customers repeatedly urging me to return as CEO. As the company faces complex technical, market, competitive and geopolitical challenges, many continue to reach out to me directly. Nvidia is a once‑in‑a‑generation company. If the board believes my return serves the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, I would be honored to answer those calls and resume the CEO role.
Thank you again to everyone who has sent me well‑wishes. Your support makes me feel humbled.
To my family: I love you and will spend the rest of my life working to be worthy of your love.

items.title: AI燒錢不愁金主的時代結束了？輝達風波敲響警鐘
items.title_en: Is the Era of AI Burning Cash Without Worrying About Backers Over? Nvidia Turmoil Sounds the Alarm
paras: 據《路透》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)領導層動盪，正讓支撐 AI 產業快速擴張的寬裕融資環境面臨考驗。投資人擔憂，黃仁勳離任後，接班人可能收緊對合作夥伴的融資與擔保支持，使高度依賴舉債的新興雲端業者承受更大壓力，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)已出現股債雙跌。
過去幾年，輝達透過投資、供應商融資與擔保等方式，協助基礎設施業者擴張。如今接班人選未定，市場開始重新評估，這些企業未來還能獲得多少資金支持。

新興雲端股債雙殺 融資壓力浮現

CoreWeave、Nebius 等「新興雲端業者」(neocloud)，主要採購繪圖處理器(GPU)，再將算力出租給 AI 開發商、新創及大型科技企業。這些公司財務規模相對有限，卻須投入鉅資購買晶片、興建資料中心，因此高度依賴外部融資。
CoreWeave 今年6月以9.625%殖利率發行的債券，近期價格重挫，殖利率攀升至接近15%；自那斯達克指數10月6日創下最近一次歷史新高以來，股價已下跌45%。
公司上周表示，仍可透過以晶片抵押借款等方式取得資金。輝達除了持有其股份，也依據63億美元訂單，承諾在2032年4月前承購未售出的雲端算力。
Nebius 今年8月以4.5%殖利率發行的可轉換公司債，上周五跌至面額的70%，殖利率升破12%；股價自10月6日以來下跌57%。輝達今年3月曾宣布投資20億美元，取得該公司8.3%股權。

既有承諾料不變 接班人是否繼續支持成關鍵

惠靈頓資產管理固定收益投資組合經理 Loren Moran 表示，無論誰接任，在運用輝達資產負債表承擔風險時，都可能比黃仁勳保守，財務較弱業者能取得的融資恐因此減少。
Impax Asset Management 投資級債券投資組合經理 Tony Trzcinka 則指出，黃仁勳離任應不會改變既有合約與擔保，關鍵在於接班人是否願意繼續積極參與各種融資安排。
對輝達而言，降低風險承擔可能有利信用體質；但仰賴其直接或間接支持的企業，未來資金可能更難取得，成本也可能提高。
相較之下，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)等大型雲端業者財務較強，能透過內部現金流與債市籌資支應建設，更有能力因應融資環境轉變。

高收益債交易降溫 資金開始挑選贏家

高盛(GS-US)全球槓桿融資主管 Miriam Wheeler 指出，市場擔憂債券供給增加與政治不確定性，近幾周 AI 相關高收益債交易已明顯放緩。
市場原先預期，今年秋季相關發行規模約600億美元，一度對信用利差形成壓力；但自9月底起，供給急遽萎縮，過去一個月更沒有新交易。
Trzcinka 表示，若資料中心仍在興建，借款企業又屬高收益債等級，資金成本就會明顯提高。
TwentyFour Asset Management 投資組合經理 Danny Zaid 認為，產業不確定性升高，投資人將要求更高風險溢價，並逐一檢視企業信用體質。這意味著，即使 AI 需求持續成長，也不代表所有業者都能以相同條件取得資金，企業間的融資待遇差距將進一步擴大。
paras_en: According to Reuters, turmoil among Nvidia (NVDA-US) leadership is putting the generous financing environment that has underpinned the rapid expansion of the AI industry to the test. Investors fear that after Jensen Huang steps down, his successor may tighten financing and guarantee support for partners, increasing pressure on highly leveraged emerging cloud providers; CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Nebius (NBIS-US) have already seen both their stocks and bonds fall.

In recent years Nvidia helped infrastructure players expand through investments, supplier financing and guarantees. With a successor still undecided, the market is re‑evaluating how much funding these companies can expect in the future.

Emerging cloud stocks and bonds are being hit as financing pressure surfaces. Companies such as CoreWeave and Nebius – the so‑called “neocloud” players – mainly purchase GPUs and then lease compute capacity to AI developers, startups and large tech firms. Their financial scale is relatively limited, yet they must spend heavily on chips and data‑center construction, making them highly dependent on external financing.

CoreWeave’s bonds issued in June this year at a 9.625% yield have recently slumped in price, pushing the yield up toward 15%; since the Nasdaq index hit a recent high on October 6, the stock has fallen 45%.

The company said last week it can still raise cash by borrowing against its chip inventory. Nvidia, besides holding shares, has committed, based on a $6.3 billion order, to purchase any unsold cloud compute capacity by April 2032.

Nebius’s convertible bonds issued in August at a 4.5% yield fell to 70% of par last Friday, with the yield climbing above 12%; the stock has dropped 57% since October 6. Nvidia announced in March that it would invest $2 billion to acquire an 8.3% stake in the firm.

Existing commitments remain unchanged; whether the successor continues support is the key. Loren Moran, fixed‑income portfolio manager at Wellington Management, said that whoever takes over may be less conservative than Jensen Huang in using Nvidia’s balance sheet to assume risk, potentially reducing financing available to financially weaker firms.

Tony Trzcinka, investment‑grade bond portfolio manager at Impax Asset Management, noted that Jensen Huang’s departure should not alter existing contracts and guarantees; the crucial factor is whether the successor is willing to stay actively involved in various financing arrangements.
For Nvidia, reducing risk exposure could improve its credit profile; however, companies that rely on its direct or indirect support may find funding harder to obtain and more costly in the future.

By contrast, large cloud providers such as Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US) have stronger finances and can fund construction through internal cash flow and the bond market, giving them greater ability to cope with a shifting financing environment.

High‑yield bond trading has cooled as investors begin to pick winners. Miriam Wheeler, global leveraged finance head at Goldman Sachs (GS-US), said the market is worried about increased bond supply and political uncertainty, and AI‑related high‑yield trading has noticeably slowed in recent weeks.

The market had originally expected about $60 billion of related issuances this fall, which at one point put pressure on credit spreads; but since the end of September supply has sharply contracted, and there have been no new deals in the past month.
Trzcinka added that if data‑centers are still being built and borrowing firms are high‑yield borrowers, financing costs will rise sharply.

Danny Zaid, portfolio manager at TwentyFour Asset Management, believes rising industry uncertainty will lead investors to demand higher risk premiums and scrutinize each company’s credit quality. This means that even if AI demand continues to grow, not all players will secure funding on the same terms, and financing gaps between firms will widen further.

items.title: 黃仁勳12月1日赴美國會！眾院三委員會追查輝達國安疑慮
items.title_en: Jensen Huang to Appear Before U.S. Congress on Dec. 1; House Panels Probe Nvidia National‑Security Concerns
paras: 綜合外媒周二(17日)報導，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳已同意於12月1日，出席美國眾議院外交、情報及中國問題特別委員會的聯席會議，說明他與疑似中國間諜女子的關係，以及公司安全管理與出口管制相關問題。輝達法務長泰德(Tim Teter)則將於12月2日出席。
議員表示，兩場訪談將製作逐字紀錄，預計以閉門方式進行。此外，參議院銀行委員會也已要求黃仁勳於12月3日出席公開聽證會，顯示國會對輝達的調查壓力持續升高。

傳票壓力下接受邀請 國會追問晶片流向與機密接觸

《彭博》指出，眾院外交委員會主席馬斯特(Brian Mast)與中國問題特別委員會主席穆勒納爾(John Moolenaar)，上周曾表明可能發出傳票，要求黃仁勳出席，黃仁勳隨後接受邀請。
馬斯特、穆勒納爾與情報委員會主席克勞福(Rick Crawford)在聯合聲明中表示：「我們期待聽取黃仁勳與泰德說明，他們在這起可能危及美國國家安全的事件中所扮演的角色。」
三位主席並表示，美國民眾需要了解，黃仁勳與輝達在讓被他們視為具有威脅的中國人士取得美國最先進晶片一事中，扮演何種角色，以及一名疑似中國情報人員在風波中的涉入情況。
黃仁勳上周因婚外情風波辭職。涉事女子黃樂(Alice Huang)曾任新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed International 高層，被美國情報單位懷疑是中國間諜。輝達曾向 Megaspeed 出售晶片，華府擔憂部分晶片可能遭非法轉運至中國。
Megaspeed 因可能違反出口管制而受到美方調查，公司否認有任何不法行為。《彭博》報導，黃樂目前人在中國。
穆勒納爾15日接受《CBS》節目訪問時表示，國會希望釐清機密資訊可能遭接觸的程度，以及黃樂是否影響輝達推動有利中國持續取得晶片的政策立場。

法務長通話受檢視 參院另要求黃仁勳公開作證

泰德也將被要求說明輝達遵守出口管制的情況，以及議員所稱公司干預美國出口管制政策與調查的相關報導。
《彭博》先前披露，泰德曾於2025年夏末致電美國商務部負責執行出口管制的單位主管，詢問該機關是否參與黃樂遭新加坡當局拘留一事。
輝達對此回應，公司經常與政府官員聯繫，以回答問題並提供資訊。針對此次國會聯合聲明，黃仁勳與輝達的發言人均未立即回應；輝達周一則曾表示：「我們期待於12月2日與各委員會主席會面。」
輝達董事會已就黃仁勳與黃樂的關係展開內部調查，但也表示，目前不認為國家安全或公司機密受到損害。美國聯邦執法機關則正在進行間諜活動調查，另有可能涉及晶片走私的調查持續進行。
參院銀行委員會主席史考特(Tim Scott)已要求黃仁勳12月3日出席公開聽證會，並要求商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)於12月10日作證。這些要求與黃仁勳已同意的眾院出席安排不同，目前報導尚未確認他是否接受參院邀請。
這場風波也加強了兩黨議員將晶片出口管制措施納入年底前須通過的國防法案的力道。將於明年1月掌控參眾兩院的民主黨議員，已承諾進一步檢視黃仁勳、輝達及其他矽谷企業，相關國會調查可能持續延燒。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Tuesday the 17th, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) former chief executive Jensen Huang has agreed to attend a joint hearing of the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China‑Specific Subcommittees on Dec. 1, where he will address his relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy and issues related to the company’s security management and export controls. Nvidia’s general counsel Tim Teter will appear on Dec. 2.

Lawmakers said both interviews will be transcribed verbatim and are expected to be held behind closed doors. In addition, the Senate Banking Committee has asked Huang to appear at a public hearing on Dec. 3, indicating that congressional pressure on Nvidia continues to mount.

Under subpoena pressure, Huang accepted the invitation as Congress presses for details on chip shipments and confidential contacts. Bloomberg noted that House Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast and China‑Specific Subcommittee Chair John Moolenaar indicated last week that they might issue a subpoena for Huang, who then accepted the invitation.

Mast, Moolenaar and Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford said in a joint statement, “We look forward to hearing from Jensen Huang and Tim Teter about the role they played in this matter that could threaten U.S. national security.”

The three chairs added that the American public needs to understand what role Huang and Nvidia played in allowing individuals they deem a threat from China to obtain the United States’ most advanced chips, and the extent of involvement by a suspected Chinese intelligence operative in the controversy.

Huang stepped down last week amid an extramarital‑affair scandal. The woman involved, Alice Huang, formerly a senior executive at Singapore‑based tech firm Megaspeed International, is suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy. Nvidia had sold chips to Megaspeed, and Washington worries some of those chips may have been illegally rerouted to China.
Megaspeed is under U.S. investigation for possible export‑control violations, which the company denies. Bloomberg reports that Alice Huang is currently in China.

In a CBS interview on the 15th, Moolenaar said Congress wants to clarify how much classified information may have been accessed and whether Alice Huang influenced Nvidia’s policy stance that facilitates China’s continued chip acquisition.

General counsel Tim Teter will also be asked to explain Nvidia’s compliance with export controls and the lawmakers’ allegations that the company interfered with U.S. export‑control policy and investigations.

Bloomberg previously disclosed that Teter called the head of the Commerce Department’s export‑control enforcement unit in late summer 2025 to ask whether the agency was involved in Alice Huang’s detention by Singaporean authorities.

Nvidia responded that the company regularly contacts government officials to answer questions and provide information. Neither Huang nor Nvidia’s spokesperson immediately responded to the joint House statement; on Monday Nvidia said, “We look forward to meeting the committee chairs on Dec. 2.”

The board has launched an internal investigation into Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang but says it does not currently believe national‑security or corporate‑confidential information has been compromised. Federal law‑enforcement agencies are probing espionage activities, and a separate investigation into possible chip smuggling continues.

Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott has asked Huang to appear at a public hearing on Dec. 3 and has requested Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify on Dec. 10. These requests differ from the House appearance Huang has already agreed to, and reports have not confirmed whether he will accept the Senate invitation.

The episode has bolstered bipartisan efforts to embed chip‑export‑control measures in a defense bill that must pass before the end of the year. Democrats who will control both chambers in January have pledged to further scrutinize Huang, Nvidia and other Silicon Valley firms, suggesting the congressional probe could keep escalating.

items.title: 《大賣空》艾斯曼示警！輝達風波延燒 AI新興雲端股「麻煩大了」
paras: 據《CNBC》報導，電影《大賣空》角色原型之一、知名投資人艾斯曼(Steve Eisman)警告，輝達(NVDA-US)風波可能讓仰賴借款擴張的 AI 新興雲端業者成為最大輸家。相較之下，若資料中心建設適度放緩，他更看好大型雲端業者，認為其現金流有望改善。

輝達融資支持恐縮手 新興雲端股承壓

艾斯曼在《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」中，將輝達及其合作網絡形容為一個「實質上的垂直整合控股體系」，並認為這個體系正在瓦解。
他說：「我認為新興雲端業者都麻煩大了，因為它們是這個體系的一部分，而我認為它們即將被排除在外。」
這類業者主要透過借款興建資料中心，出租 AI 算力，在近期 AI 類股回檔中受創尤其嚴重。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)與 Nebius(NBIS-US)過去三個月股價均下跌逾50%。
輝達即將於周二盤後公布財報，同時面對黃仁勳因與一名據稱被美國情報單位懷疑是中國間諜的女子發生婚外情而離任的風波。美國商務部也已採取措施，收緊中國遠端使用資料中心的管道。
投資人擔心，隨著輝達中國相關營收受到更嚴格檢視，公司可能縮減支撐 AI 產業擴張的大規模融資安排。

建設限制比IPO更關鍵 艾斯曼偏好大型雲端商

對於預計周四上市的 Anthropic，艾斯曼認為，市場期待已經降溫，這場備受矚目的首次公開發行(IPO)，對 AI 投資行情的重要性也隨之下降。
他說：「我認為已經沒什麼人在意了。」
他更關注民主黨明年1月掌控國會並接掌多州州長職位後，地方與州政府將在多大程度上限制資料中心建設。
艾斯曼提出兩種假設。他表示，若全面暫停興建資料中心，可能迅速使美國陷入衰退；若建設僅放緩10%至30%，他最看好的則是大型雲端業者。
他說：「最受惠的族群是大型雲端業者，因為它們的現金流會重新轉正。」
這項判斷建立在建設適度放緩的情境上。相較於高度依賴融資的新興雲端業者，艾斯曼認為，大型雲端業者有機會因建設支出減少而改善現金流。

items.title: 堵中國算力繞道！美BIS晶片禁令19日生效 經部表態了！曝台廠代工申請關鍵
items.title_en: U.S. BIS Chip Ban Takes Effect on the 19th, Blocking China’s Compute Detour; Taiwan Ministry Responds, Reveals Key OEM Application
paras: 美國商務部工業暨安全局（BIS）於11月16日發布先進超級智慧（SI）晶片與伺服器遠端存取出口管制臨時最終規則草案，預計11月19日正式生效，全面防堵中國客戶透過第三國資料中心獲取雲端算力。對此，經濟部今（17）日表示，台灣半導體及AI伺服器業者主要依客戶訂單提供代工服務，若出口產品涉及美方新規定，將由下單的美國客戶向BIS提出出口許可證申請，經濟部也會持續協助國內業者落實法規遵循。
隨著人工智慧技術快速演進，美國政府為防止敏感運算技術外流，持續升級對中國的科技圍堵網。過往美方主要管制高階AI晶片與伺服器直接輸往中國，或是中國企業在海外子公司的資料中心，但近期發現有業者藉由第三國資料中心提供遠端雲端算力服務來規避禁令，促使美方決定大舉擴大管制範圍並限縮相關豁免條款。
針對美方最新發布的管制措施，經濟部指出，台美雙方長期就出口管制、供應鏈安全及經濟安全等重要議題保持密切對話，雙方更於今年2月正式簽訂對等貿易協定，承諾進一步強化在出口管制領域的合作。面對美國政府本次推出新規以彌補潛在的管制漏洞，經濟部將持續與美方針對具體管制作法深入交換意見，攜手共同防堵任何違規轉運行為，確保全球科技供應鏈的安全與穩定。
檢視本次美國商務部發布的新規細節，管制力道主要有三大升級重點。首先在擴大管制方面，針對提供雲端算力服務給中國客戶的第三國資料中心，未來出口先進晶片至這類雲端運算用途的資料中心，均須事先取得許可。其次，本案增列5個高轉運風險國家的許可證要求，未來向印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國等4個東協國家以及巴西出口先進晶片，皆須依法申請出口許可。
此外，新規也大幅限縮晶圓製造廠及封測廠（OSAT）的豁免審查空間。過往經美國商務部核准的晶圓製造與封測大廠，可享有豁免申請晶片出口許可的待遇，但未來即便已獲核准，只要前端晶片設計商位於中國、印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國或巴西等地，將不再適用該項許可豁免，必須一體適用管制晶片規定並事先申請出口許可。經濟部強調，將持續掌握美方執行細節並舉辦宣導活動，提醒台廠留意法規調整。
paras_en: On November 16, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) released a draft of the final interim rules for export controls on advanced superintelligence (SI) chips and remote server access, slated to take effect on November 19. The rules aim to fully block Chinese customers from obtaining cloud compute power via third‑country data centers. In response, Taiwan’s Ministry of Economic Affairs said on the 17th that Taiwanese semiconductor and AI server firms mainly provide foundry services based on customer orders; if exported products fall under the new U.S. regulations, the U.S. customer placing the order will apply for an export license from BIS, and the ministry will continue to help domestic firms comply with the rules.

As AI technology rapidly evolves, the U.S. government is continuously tightening its tech containment network against China to prevent the leakage of sensitive computing capabilities. Previously, U.S. controls focused on direct shipments of high‑end AI chips and servers to China or to data centers of Chinese subsidiaries abroad. Recently, however, authorities discovered that some firms were offering remote cloud compute services through third‑country data centers to evade the ban, prompting the U.S. to dramatically broaden the scope of controls and narrow related exemption clauses.

Regarding the latest U.S. measures, the Ministry of Economic Affairs noted that Taiwan and the United States have long maintained close dialogue on export controls, supply‑chain security, and economic security, and that the two sides signed a reciprocal trade agreement in February this year to further strengthen cooperation in export control matters. Facing the new U.S. rules designed to close potential loopholes, the ministry will keep exchanging detailed views with the U.S. on specific regulatory implementations, working together to block any illicit transshipment and ensure the safety and stability of the global technology supply chain.

A review of the new BIS regulations shows three major upgrades in control intensity. First, the export of advanced chips to third‑country data centers that provide cloud compute services to Chinese customers will now require prior permission. Second, the rule adds license‑requirement obligations for five high‑risk transshipment countries; exports of advanced chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil will all need to obtain an export license under the law.

Finally, the new rules sharply narrow the exemption space for wafer foundries and OSATs. Previously, large wafer‑fab and packaging firms approved by the U.S. Commerce Department could enjoy exemption from chip‑export licensing. Under the new regime, even approved firms will lose that exemption if the front‑end chip designer is located in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil, and must instead comply with the full control regime and obtain a license in advance. The ministry emphasized it will keep track of U.S. implementation details and hold outreach activities to remind Taiwanese companies of the regulatory changes.

items.title: 輝達面臨的挑戰不止於黃仁勳離職！摩根大通示警「兩大成長」引擎承壓
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 面臨的挑戰，可能不只執行長黃仁勳離任所帶來的管理層變動，人工智慧（AI）晶片市場競爭加劇，以及開源模型生態系面臨的美國出口管制，也正對公司長期成長動能構成壓力。
摩根大通策略師Michael Cembalest在最新研究報告《輝達與AI的下一步》中指出，尖端AI實驗室正逐步分散算力採購來源，將訂單轉向超微半導體(AMD-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 等競爭對手。預計於2026年後部署的算力協議，輝達GPU僅占28%。
另一方面，開源模型生態系也面臨美國政府監管壓力。這兩項發展分別牽動輝達的AI晶片定價能力，以及開源市場需求，可能動搖過去支撐公司高估值的兩大成長引擎。
Cembalest認為，市場競爭格局的變化，對投資人的重要性在某種程度上不亞於管理層變動，甚至可能更加深遠。

AI算力採購分散　輝達協議占比僅28%

Cembalest統計主要尖端AI實驗室已公布、預計於2026年後部署的算力協議，總規模約44吉瓦（GW），其中採用輝達GPU的算力約12.1GW，占比僅28%。
其餘算力來源包括博通(AVGO-US) 客製化晶片，占23%；超微半導體 占18%；亞馬遜Trainium占16%；Google TPU占14%；Cerebras(CBRS-US) 則占2%。
這與輝達在2024至2025年間占據AI晶片營收80%至90%的市場地位形成鮮明對比。
在七大AI加速晶片採購業者中，除了SpaceX(SPCX-US) 尚未推進自研晶片計畫，其餘業者都已設法發展替代方案，以降低對輝達GPU的依賴，並避開其高達75%的毛利率所反映的成本壓力。
這股趨勢早已浮現。2025年10月，OpenAI與超微半導體簽署多吉瓦規模的算力協議，消息公布當天，超微半導體股價創下近十年來最大單日漲幅。

CUDA生態系優勢鬆動　晶片轉移時間大幅縮短

輝達長期以來的重要競爭壁壘，是CUDA軟體生態系。由於客戶若要從輝達平台轉換至其他硬體，需要投入大量工程資源與時間，因此過去不容易轉移。
但Cembalest引述與一家尖端AI實驗室的交流指出，AI工具正在降低轉換門檻。一年前，將模型移植至超微半導體 GPU需要6至12個月，過程繁瑣且工程成本高昂；如今透過最新AI模型協助工程作業，新模型移植至超微半導體 GPU只需約3天。
硬體效能方面，Epoch AI的推論基準測試顯示，超微半導體 MI455X的綜合評分約為輝達GB300的2.9倍，也高於輝達自家Vera Rubin VR200約2.2倍的評分。
此外，Google TPU7x在每美元算力指標上，除了最低速區間之外，也全面領先輝達GB300 NVL72。
Cembalest也承認，輝達預計於2027年推出的Rubin Ultra可能改變目前的競爭局面，但在AI晶片市場快速演變之際，這段等待時間仍可能讓競爭對手持續擴大優勢。

開源模型市場面臨出口管制　輝達海外營收受關注

除了晶片市場競爭，開源模型生態系也是輝達的重要客戶群體。Cembalest指出，開源權重模型社群是輝達的核心市場之一，這些模型在OpenRouter平台消耗了大部分推論算力，能力也持續追近閉源尖端模型。
然而，開源模型市場正面臨美國出口管制帶來的不確定性。SemiAnalysis估計，已有約1.5GW受限制的輝達晶片流入海外市場，並指出輝達是相關供應鏈的重要一環，無論是否出於主動。
Cembalest也援引數據指出，美國拜登政府實施出口管制後，輝達來自新加坡地址的營收占比，已從8%升至22%；輝達則從2025年7月起停止單獨揭露這項數據。
高盛分析師Jim Schneider上周五也警告，輝達在特定司法管轄區的營運可能面臨更多審查。
Cembalest並引用前Stratechery撰稿人Andrew Sharp的評論，指出輝達在享有美國市場、法律制度及客戶帶來的利益之際，其行事方式卻不像一家對美國政府負責的美國企業。

估值具吸引力　但獲利成長預期面臨考驗

儘管提出多項風險，Cembalest並未因此看空輝達。他指出，輝達在2023至2025年間取得AI晶片市場83%的營收，毛利率高達75%，且晶片設計週期漫長。
以估值來看，輝達股價較歷史高點下跌32%，本益成長比（PEG）僅0.2倍。Cembalest認為，對長期投資人而言，輝達仍具吸引力，也是大型AI類股中估值最低的標的。
不過，0.2倍的PEG建立在市場共識預期的獲利成長能夠實現的前提上，而這項預期正面臨兩大挑戰：尖端AI實驗室加快採購競爭對手的晶片，開源模型買家則可能必須取得許可證，才能繼續採購相關產品。
Cembalest總結，輝達面臨的不只有管理層變動，AI晶片市場競爭加劇，以及開源模型市場受到監管，同樣是值得警惕的風險。

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI股能否翻身？主要指數漲跌互現 市場屏息等輝達財報
paras: 美股主要指數周二(17日)開盤走勢不一，道瓊工業指數受家得寶(HD-US)財報拖累下跌，那斯達克指數開高後震盪，盤初在晶片股支撐下徘徊平盤附近。投資人聚焦輝達(NVDA-US)盤後財報，盼從最新業績與財測，尋找AI需求及科技股後市的方向。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近330點或近0.6%，那斯達克綜合指數跌0.06%，標普 500 指數跌近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近0.7%，台積電ADR跌逾1.0%。
美股賣壓周二出現緩和跡象，跌深科技股吸引買盤回流，投資人將焦點轉向輝達(NVDA-US)盤後財報，尋找 AI 產業前景的關鍵線索。不過，美國10月零售銷售優於預期，強化市場對下月升息的預期，美債回吐稍早漲幅。
那斯達克100指數期貨上漲0.3%，此前該指數連續兩個交易日重挫，累計跌幅達6%；標普500指數期貨則下跌0.1%。輝達盤前上漲0.9%，晶片股同步走揚，布蘭特原油價格升破每桶93美元。

輝達財報成AI信心考驗 強勁業績未必足以救市

輝達即將公布財報之際，正面臨黃仁勳離任引發的重大動盪。除了季度業績與財測，市場也希望確認，新領導團隊能否延續合作夥伴關係，並讓產品開發計畫如期推進。
瑞訊銀行分析師 Ipek Ozkardeskaya 表示，投資人將仔細檢視營收成長、利潤率、客戶承諾，以及輝達對中國市場的曝險，包括出口管制收緊帶來的影響。輝達稍早已宣布，成立新的董事會委員會，監督國家安全與出口管制事務。
盛寶銀行英國策略師 Neil Wilson 預期，輝達財報將非常強勁，但強勁業績未必足以支撐市場，因為目前還有太多其他因素同時影響投資情緒。
美國限制中國取得先進 AI 晶片與伺服器的新措施，也讓亞洲市場承壓。MSCI 亞太指數下跌1.5%，科技股成為主要拖累，台股加權指數下跌2.3%，南韓 Kospi 指數則下跌2.6%。

基金大砍科技股部位 零售強勁削弱美債避險效果

AI 樂觀情緒降溫之際，基金經理人也大幅降低科技股配置。美國銀行(BAC-US)於11月6日至12日進行的調查顯示，基金經理人對科技股的淨加碼比率，從10月的37%降至12%，減碼幅度為20年來最大。
不過，市場仍有逢低布局的聲音。Jefferies(JEF-US)策略師 Mohit Kumar 表示，並不擔心 AI 投資主題偏離成長軌道，但一直建議分散配置。隨著部分個股估值開始具有吸引力，近期跌勢也帶來買進機會。
傳統避險資產則未見明顯買盤。美國零售銷售優於預期，支持經濟需求仍強的看法，也強化聯準會(Fed)下月升息的理由，美債因此回吐漲幅，黃金與美元變動不大。
駿利亨德森(JHG-US)投資組合經理 Oliver Blackbourn 表示，目前要尋找避險去處並不容易，強勁成長與通膨使美債難以發揮往常的保護作用。不過，以目前殖利率水準而言，美債在投資組合中的避險潛力，已較過去很長一段時間改善。
歐洲股市同樣承壓，Stoxx 600指數出現逾一周最大跌幅。德意志銀行(DB-US)則因《金融時報》報導其曾處理與艾普斯坦(Jeffrey Epstein)有關的可疑款項，股價下跌逾4%。

items.title: 華航公益棒球營 攜手這4位旅外球星傳承棒球夢
items.title_en: China Airlines Charity Baseball Camp Teams Up with Four Overseas Players to Pass On Baseball Dreams
paras: 華航(2610-TW)長期深耕基層體育發展，今(17)日於屏東糖廠棒壘球場舉辦第七屆公益棒球營，由董事長高星潢與資深副總經理羅雅美共同揭開活動序幕，並邀請旅外球星鄭宗哲、陳柏毓、林家正和林昱珉組成豪華教練團，陪伴來自屏東縣鶴聲國中、里港國中和高泰國中共120位小球員展開一日棒球訓練交流，將寶貴經驗傳承給下一代。
華航秉持「飛更遠，愛無限（Flying beyond, Caring more）」核心理念，本屆公益棒球營特別選在屏東舉辦，高星潢表示，期盼透過企業力量支持基層體育，為年輕選手創造更多成長機會。
此次活動除安排專業訓練課程外，也特別捐贈訓練球予參與學校。
身為屏東縣鶴聲國中校友的鄭宗哲回到母校授課感觸良多表示，站在學弟們每天練習的場地上，彷彿看見昔日努力的自己，很感謝華航攜手返鄉回饋家鄉，也希望透過自身經驗鼓勵孩子們相信自己、勇敢追夢。
公益棒球營課程內容豐富多元，鄭宗哲、陳柏毓、林家正和林昱珉親自示範棒球動作要領，協助小球員強化基本功與實戰能力，現場安排成果驗收活動，由球星們親自帶隊進行模擬實戰對抗，讓學員將當天所學應用於比賽情境中，感受職業球員的訓練與比賽氛圍。
隨後舉辦分享會和Q&A交流環節，四位選手和小球員分享旅外經驗及心路歷程；陳柏毓勉勵小球員，享受棒球、不要害怕重複練習，基本功越穩固、上場就越有自信；林家正則鼓勵孩子們勇於嘗試不同守備位置，給自己更多機會發掘適合的舞台；林昱珉認為，棒球之路難免會遇到挑戰與挫折，但只要保持熱情並持續努力，每一次練習都會成為成長的養分。
華航多年來推動公益棒球營、籃球營、羽球營、桌球營等運動扎根計畫，結合企業資源和運動明星影響力，陪伴更多孩子拓展視野、朝夢想邁進；同時，舉辦華航馬拉松星光夜跑，以創新多元方式推廣全民運動。
華航強調，將持續發揮企業影響力，深化環境永續、社會關懷等面向，攜手各界創造更多公益價值，為社會帶來更多溫暖與正向力量。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) has long been devoted to grassroots sports development. Today (the 17th) it held the 7th Charity Baseball Camp at the Pingtung Sugar Factory baseball field, with Chairman Gao Xinghuang and senior vice‑president Luo Yamei opening the event. Four overseas players – Zheng Zongzhe, Chen Baiyu, Lin Jiazheng and Lin Yumin – formed a star‑studded coaching team to guide 120 young players from Hesheng Junior High, Ligang Junior High and Gaotai Junior High in Pingtung County through a day of baseball training and exchange, passing on valuable experience to the next generation.

China Airlines upholds its core philosophy “Flying beyond, Caring more,” and chose Pingtung for this year’s camp. Chairman Gao said the aim is to leverage corporate strength to support grassroots sports and create more growth opportunities for young athletes.
In addition to professional training sessions, the event also donated training balls to the participating schools.

Zheng Zongzhe, an alumnus of Hesheng Junior High in Pingtung County, returned to his alma mater to teach and expressed deep emotion. He said standing on the field where his juniors practice feels like seeing his younger self’s hard work. He thanked China Airlines for partnering to give back to his hometown and hopes his experience will encourage the kids to believe in themselves and bravely chase their dreams.

The camp’s curriculum was rich and varied. Zheng, Chen, Lin Jiazheng and Lin Yumin demonstrated baseball techniques, helping the youngsters strengthen fundamentals and game skills. A results‑verification activity was arranged on site, with the stars leading simulated games so participants could apply what they learned in a match setting and feel the training and competition atmosphere of professional players.

A sharing session and Q&A followed, where the four players and the youngsters discussed overseas experiences and personal journeys. Chen urged the kids to enjoy baseball and not fear repetitive practice, noting that solid fundamentals boost confidence on the field. Lin Jiazheng encouraged trying different defensive positions to discover the best fit, while Lin Yumin said the baseball path inevitably brings challenges, but maintaining passion and continual effort turns every practice into growth nourishment.

For years China Airlines has promoted charity camps for baseball, basketball, badminton, table tennis and other sports, combining corporate resources with the influence of sports stars to help more children broaden their horizons and pursue their dreams. It also hosts the China Airlines Marathon Star‑Light Night Run, using innovative, diverse methods to promote mass fitness.

China Airlines emphasizes that it will continue to wield its corporate influence to deepen environmental sustainability, social care and other areas, partnering with all sectors to create greater public‑benefit value, bringing more warmth and positive energy to society.

items.title: 堵中國算力繞道！美BIS晶片禁令19日生效 經部表態了！曝台廠代工申請關鍵
items.title_en: U.S. BIS Chip Ban Takes Effect on the 19th, Blocking China’s Compute Detour; Taiwan Ministry Responds, Reveals Key OEM Application
paras: 美國商務部工業暨安全局（BIS）於11月16日發布先進超級智慧（SI）晶片與伺服器遠端存取出口管制臨時最終規則草案，預計11月19日正式生效，全面防堵中國客戶透過第三國資料中心獲取雲端算力。對此，經濟部今（17）日表示，台灣半導體及AI伺服器業者主要依客戶訂單提供代工服務，若出口產品涉及美方新規定，將由下單的美國客戶向BIS提出出口許可證申請，經濟部也會持續協助國內業者落實法規遵循。
隨著人工智慧技術快速演進，美國政府為防止敏感運算技術外流，持續升級對中國的科技圍堵網。過往美方主要管制高階AI晶片與伺服器直接輸往中國，或是中國企業在海外子公司的資料中心，但近期發現有業者藉由第三國資料中心提供遠端雲端算力服務來規避禁令，促使美方決定大舉擴大管制範圍並限縮相關豁免條款。
針對美方最新發布的管制措施，經濟部指出，台美雙方長期就出口管制、供應鏈安全及經濟安全等重要議題保持密切對話，雙方更於今年2月正式簽訂對等貿易協定，承諾進一步強化在出口管制領域的合作。面對美國政府本次推出新規以彌補潛在的管制漏洞，經濟部將持續與美方針對具體管制作法深入交換意見，攜手共同防堵任何違規轉運行為，確保全球科技供應鏈的安全與穩定。
檢視本次美國商務部發布的新規細節，管制力道主要有三大升級重點。首先在擴大管制方面，針對提供雲端算力服務給中國客戶的第三國資料中心，未來出口先進晶片至這類雲端運算用途的資料中心，均須事先取得許可。其次，本案增列5個高轉運風險國家的許可證要求，未來向印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國等4個東協國家以及巴西出口先進晶片，皆須依法申請出口許可。
此外，新規也大幅限縮晶圓製造廠及封測廠（OSAT）的豁免審查空間。過往經美國商務部核准的晶圓製造與封測大廠，可享有豁免申請晶片出口許可的待遇，但未來即便已獲核准，只要前端晶片設計商位於中國、印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國或巴西等地，將不再適用該項許可豁免，必須一體適用管制晶片規定並事先申請出口許可。經濟部強調，將持續掌握美方執行細節並舉辦宣導活動，提醒台廠留意法規調整。
paras_en: On November 16, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) released a draft of the final interim rules for export controls on advanced superintelligence (SI) chips and remote server access, slated to take effect on November 19. The rules aim to fully block Chinese customers from obtaining cloud compute power via third‑country data centers. In response, Taiwan’s Ministry of Economic Affairs said on the 17th that Taiwanese semiconductor and AI server firms mainly provide foundry services based on customer orders; if exported products fall under the new U.S. regulations, the U.S. customer placing the order will apply for an export license from BIS, and the ministry will continue to help domestic firms comply with the rules.

As AI technology rapidly evolves, the U.S. government is continuously tightening its tech containment network against China to prevent the leakage of sensitive computing capabilities. Previously, U.S. controls focused on direct shipments of high‑end AI chips and servers to China or to data centers of Chinese subsidiaries abroad. Recently, however, authorities discovered that some firms were offering remote cloud compute services through third‑country data centers to evade the ban, prompting the U.S. to dramatically broaden the scope of controls and narrow related exemption clauses.

Regarding the latest U.S. measures, the Ministry of Economic Affairs noted that Taiwan and the United States have long maintained close dialogue on export controls, supply‑chain security, and economic security, and that the two sides signed a reciprocal trade agreement in February this year to further strengthen cooperation in export control matters. Facing the new U.S. rules designed to close potential loopholes, the ministry will keep exchanging detailed views with the U.S. on specific regulatory implementations, working together to block any illicit transshipment and ensure the safety and stability of the global technology supply chain.

A review of the new BIS regulations shows three major upgrades in control intensity. First, the export of advanced chips to third‑country data centers that provide cloud compute services to Chinese customers will now require prior permission. Second, the rule adds license‑requirement obligations for five high‑risk transshipment countries; exports of advanced chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil will all need to obtain an export license under the law.

Finally, the new rules sharply narrow the exemption space for wafer foundries and OSATs. Previously, large wafer‑fab and packaging firms approved by the U.S. Commerce Department could enjoy exemption from chip‑export licensing. Under the new regime, even approved firms will lose that exemption if the front‑end chip designer is located in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil, and must instead comply with the full control regime and obtain a license in advance. The ministry emphasized it will keep track of U.S. implementation details and hold outreach activities to remind Taiwanese companies of the regulatory changes.

items.title: 台股續跌險守4萬關 證交所連二日信心喊話：基本面穩健、追繳風險可控
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Slip Below 40,000 Points; Exchange Calls for Confidence: Fundamentals Solid, Margin Call Risks Manageable
paras: 受市場對AI產業前景疑慮拖累，台股今(17)日隨國際主要股市同步震盪，加權股價指數終場重挫947.97點，跌幅2.31%，以40,092.11點作收，險守4萬點大關。面對市場恐慌情緒，證交所連續第二天發布新聞稿向市場信心喊話，強調國際金融機構仍看好AI中長期發展，且國內上市公司前三季獲利暴增逾八成、信用交易風險可控，呼籲投資人回歸基本面理性判斷。
證交所指出，針對近期科技股修正，瑞銀集團(UBS)認為主要反映投資部位調整而非AI投資循環結束，持續看好結構性成長機會；摩根大通私人銀行看好未來12至18個月大型雲端業者前景，預期AI長期將帶動生產力與經濟成長；貝萊德(BlackRock)則對AI長期發展潛力維持樂觀。
在信用交易風險方面，截至16日全市場信用交易擔保維持率仍達165.98%，遠高於130%的最低追繳門檻。目前追繳戶數733戶，追繳與處分金額分別為3.97億元與5.67億元，相較大盤成交金額占比極低。證交所強調，與去年4月美國對等關稅事件相比，現階段市場追繳壓力相對和緩，處分規模與人數均在安全範圍內，整體交易秩序正常。
根據證交所統計，今年前三季本國上市公司(不含金控及未申報公司)累計營收達45兆4,758億元，年增38.29%；稅前淨利達6兆2,273億元，年增82.69%，呈現營收與獲利雙雙大幅成長的亮眼格局。全市場具獲利之上市公司達872家(約占81%)，獲利較去年同期成長者達775家(約占72%)。
從產業別觀察，半導體業憑藉領先技術掌握AI商機；電腦及周邊設備業受惠雲端業者擴大AI基礎建設；電子零組件業則受AI伺服器及高效能運算需求帶動，獲利全面走揚。此外，玻璃陶瓷及塑膠工業亦受惠相關需求，由去年同期虧損轉為獲利，顯示AI產業成長效益已擴散至其他產業。
證交所強調，目前台股信用交易維持率充足，企業營運成果亦展現成長動能，面對短期國際股市波動，投資人應審慎評估自身風險承受能力、留意槓桿交易風險，並回歸企業基本面理性判斷，共同維護資本市場長期穩健發展。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market fell today (the 17th) in line with major international indices as concerns over the AI industry's outlook weighed on sentiment. The weighted index closed down 947.97 points, a 2.31% drop, at 40,092.11 points, just shy of the 40,000‑point threshold. Facing market panic, the exchange issued a second consecutive press release urging confidence, stressing that international financial institutions remain bullish on AI’s medium‑to‑long‑term prospects, domestic listed companies posted more than an 80% profit surge in the first three quarters, and margin‑trading risks are under control, urging investors to return to fundamentals for rational judgment.

The exchange noted that recent tech‑stock corrections are, according to UBS, mainly a portfolio rebalancing rather than the end of the AI investment cycle, and it continues to see structural growth opportunities. JPMorgan private banking is optimistic about large cloud providers over the next 12‑18 months, expecting AI to drive productivity and economic growth in the long run. BlackRock also maintains a positive outlook on AI’s long‑term development potential.

Regarding margin‑trading risk, as of the 16th the market‑wide margin‑maintenance ratio remained at 165.98%, well above the 130% minimum margin‑call threshold. There are currently 733 margin‑call accounts, with margin‑call and penalty amounts of NT$397 million and NT$567 million respectively, a tiny share of total market turnover. The exchange emphasized that, compared with the U.S. tariff‑equivalence episode in April last year, current margin‑call pressure is relatively mild, with both the scale and number of penalties within safe limits and overall trading order normal.

According to exchange data, domestic listed companies (excluding financial holding companies and unreported firms) generated cumulative revenue of NT$45.4758 trillion in the first three quarters of this year, up 38.29% year‑on‑year, and pre‑tax net profit reached NT$6.2273 trillion, up 82.69%, showcasing a striking pattern of strong revenue and profit growth. A total of 872 listed companies (about 81% of the market) were profitable, and 775 of them (about 72%) posted higher earnings than the same period last year.

Sector‑wise, the semiconductor industry is capitalising on AI opportunities with its leading technology; the computer and peripheral equipment sector benefits from cloud providers expanding AI infrastructure; electronic components are buoyed by demand for AI servers and high‑performance computing, driving profit gains across the board. Moreover, the glass‑ceramic and plastics industries have turned from losses to profits thanks to related demand, indicating that AI‑driven growth benefits are spreading to other sectors.

The exchange stressed that Taiwan’s margin‑maintenance ratio remains ample and corporate operating results demonstrate growth momentum. Facing short‑term international market volatility, investors should carefully assess their risk tolerance, watch for leverage‑trading risks, and revert to rational, fundamentals‑based judgments to jointly safeguard the long‑term, healthy development of the capital market.

items.title: 證交所Q3財報審閱出爐：力銘、正峰11/19起列全額交割 台揚12/21下市
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Exchange Q3 Financial Report Review Released: Li Ming and Zheng Feng to Switch to Full Delivery from Nov 19, Tai Yang Delisted Dec 21
paras: 臺灣證券交易所於今(17)日公布上市公司2026年第3季財務報告形式審閱結果與相關處置情形。其中，正峰(1538-TW)因會計師出具繼續經營能力存在重大不確定性之核閱報告，上市有價證券將併案列為變更交易方法(全額交割)；力銘(3593-TW)因淨值低於股本十分之三，將繼續列為變更交易方法並加採分盤集合競價交易；而台揚科技(2314-TW)則因淨值轉為負數，先前已公告將於12月21日起終止上市。
證交所表示，本次針對上市公司(扣除金控公司13家因申報期限至11/30外)第3季財報進行形式審閱，相關處置措施將自115年11月19日起正式執行。
正峰工業先前已因符合相關規定遭列為變更交易方法在案；本次因最近期公告申報之財報經會計師出具「繼續經營能力存在重大不確定性」之核閱報告，證交所依規定將其上市有價證券併案列為變更交易方法。
力銘科技先前同樣因故被列為變更交易方法；根據其最新申報之財報顯示，淨值已低於所列示股本的十分之三，因此證交所宣布其有價證券繼續列為變更交易方法，並同步加採行分盤集合競價交易方式。
台揚科技先前已因多項規定被列為變更交易方法並採行分盤集合競價交易。因其最新財報顯示淨值已為負數，符合終止上市規定，證交所先前已正式公告其有價證券將自今年12月21日起終止上市。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced today (the 17th) the results of its formal review of listed companies’ Q3 2026 financial reports and the related actions. Zheng Feng (1538‑TW) received an auditor’s review report indicating a material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern, so its listed securities will be treated as a change of trading method to full delivery; Li Ming (3593‑TW) has net assets less than one‑tenth of its share capital, and will continue to be subject to a change of trading method with the addition of split‑lot collective auction trading; Tai Yang Technology (2314‑TW) now has negative net assets and has previously announced that its listing will be terminated effective December 21.

The exchange noted that this formal review covered Q3 reports of listed companies (excluding 13 financial holding companies whose filing deadline extends to Nov 30). The related measures will take effect starting Nov 19, 2025.

Zheng Feng Industrial had already been designated for a change of trading method under applicable rules. This time, because the most recent filed report included an auditor’s review stating a material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern, the exchange is classifying its listed securities as a case for change of trading method in accordance with regulations.

Li Ming Technology had also previously been placed under a change of trading method. According to its latest filed report, net assets have fallen below one‑tenth of the disclosed share capital, so the exchange announced that its securities will remain under the change‑of‑trading‑method regime and will additionally adopt split‑lot collective auction trading.

Tai Yang Technology had previously been placed under a change of trading method and subject to split‑lot collective auction trading due to several regulatory breaches. Its latest report shows net assets are now negative, meeting the criteria for delisting; the exchange has already formally announced that its securities will be delisted effective Dec 21 this year.

items.title: 鴻海72億日圓收購Sony車載相機模組業務 切入日系車廠供應鏈
items.title_en: Foxconn to Acquire Sony's Automotive Camera Module Business for 7.24 Billion Yen, Entering Japanese Automaker Supply Chain
paras: 2026年11月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 鴻海(2317-TW)宣布，以72.4億日圓（約新台幣15億元）收購日本索尼集團Sony Group(6758-JP)旗下半導體子公司的車載相機模組業務，預計2027年4月底前完成交易。這是鴻海繼2025年收購夏普相機模組業務及越南Saigon STEC後，再度擴大光學零組件布局，並從手機相機模組延伸至車用市場。
鴻海原本就有相機模組業務，相關產品歸屬於「元件及其他產品」事業下的光學類別，涵蓋觸控模組、相機模組及點陣投影機模組等。近年公司透過併購擴大規模，2025年6月由旗下Fullertain承接夏普相機模組業務，同月底再取得越南手機相機模組製造商Saigon STEC全部股權，強化光學零組件的製造與整合能力。
此次收購主要涉及Sony位於泰國的車載相機模組業務，負責將CMOS影像感測器、鏡頭及周邊零組件組裝成相機模組。Sony本身是車用影像感測器供應商，相關模組業務也已建立日本汽車製造商客戶基礎。對鴻海而言，此次交易不只是取得製造技術，也有機會承接既有日系車廠供應關係，擴大汽車電子業務。
車載相機是先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)及車內監控的重要零組件，產業分工涵蓋上游CMOS影像感測器、光學鏡頭、中游模組組裝及下游車用系統整合。Sony的技術優勢主要集中在影像感測器，鴻海則透過承接模組業務，擴大既有電子製造與車用零組件產品線。
不過，72.4億日圓並非最終完整收購成本，部分海外生產設備及存貨尚未納入交易價格，後續若一併取得，總金額可能增加。

paras_en: On November 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Foxconn (2317-TW) announced it will acquire Sony Group's (6758-JP) automotive camera module business, a semiconductor subsidiary, for 7.24 billion yen (about NT$1.5 billion), with the transaction expected to close by the end of April 2027. This follows Foxconn’s 2025 purchase of Sharp’s camera module business and Vietnam’s Saigon STEC, further expanding its optical component portfolio from smartphone camera modules into the automotive market.

Foxconn already operates a camera‑module business under its “Components and Other Products” segment, covering optical categories such as touch modules, camera modules and pico‑projector modules. In recent years the company has grown through acquisitions: in June 2025 its subsidiary Fullertain took over Sharp’s camera‑module business, and later that month it acquired 100% of Vietnam‑based mobile camera‑module maker Saigon STEC, strengthening its manufacturing and integration capabilities for optical components.

The acquisition targets Sony’s automotive camera‑module operation located in Thailand, which assembles CMOS image sensors, lenses and related parts into camera modules. Sony itself is a supplier of automotive image sensors and has already built a customer base among Japanese car manufacturers. For Foxconn, the deal brings not only manufacturing technology but also the chance to inherit existing supply relationships with Japanese automakers, expanding its automotive electronics business.

Automotive cameras are key components for advanced driver‑assistance systems (ADAS) and in‑vehicle monitoring, with the industry chain spanning upstream CMOS sensors, optical lenses, mid‑stream module assembly and downstream vehicle‑system integration. Sony’s technical edge lies mainly in image sensors, while Foxconn will leverage the module‑assembly business to broaden its existing electronics manufacturing and automotive component product lines.

However, the 7.24 billion yen price does not represent the final total cost; some overseas production equipment and inventory have not yet been included in the transaction price, and the overall amount could increase if those assets are later acquired.

items.title: 櫃買爆2檔違約交割逾6500萬元 千金股旺矽今年二度上榜
items.title_en: OTC Market Reports Two Default Deliveries Exceeding NT$65 Million; High‑Priced Stock Wan‑Silicon Listed Twice This Year
paras: 櫃買中心今(17)日公告，上櫃新增 2 起個股違約交割通報，分別為測試介面千金股旺矽(6223-TW)及太陽能網版廠倉和(6538-TW)，合計違約金額達6,502.1萬元；這也是今年以來櫃買市場累計的第17及第18起違約交割案件。
根據櫃買中心公布資料，旺矽此次違約交割金額高達5,406萬元，由臺銀金山、德信、新光等三家券商分點通報；倉和違約交割金額則為1,096.1萬元，通報券商分點包括華南台南、永豐潮州及永豐桃園。
值得留意的是，高價股旺矽今年已非首度發生違約交割。回顧今年6月12日，旺矽便曾由永豐金證券萬盛分公司通報違約交割1,207萬元；加計今日通報的5,406萬元後，旺矽今年以來累計違約交割金額已達6,613萬元。
依據台股「T+2」交割制度回推，17日通報的違約交割，其交易發生日為13日。觀察上周五兩檔個股盤面表現，走勢皆出現劇烈震盪，成為引爆違約的關鍵。
其中，旺矽13日以4,910元開高後，盤中一度衝上5,100元高點，但隨後賣壓湧現、股價大幅拉回，盤中最低下探至4,630元，高低點震幅逾一成，終場僅小漲15元、收在4,670元，漲幅0.32%；倉和13日同樣開高走低，早盤以337元開出，最高觸及338元後反轉急殺，盤中直接打入跌停價293.5元並鎖死至終場，重挫32.5元、跌幅達9.97%。
市場人士分析，兩檔個股當日均出現「開高走低」的急殺走勢，導致追高搶短或當沖做多的投資人措手不及，一旦未備足交割款項，便在今日爆發大額違約交割。
提醒投資人，從事有價證券交易時，應審慎評估自身財務狀況與交割能力，避免過度擴張信用進行高槓桿或當沖操作，以免因無法如期履行交割義務，面臨信用受損及相關法律責任。
paras_en: The OTC Center announced today (the 17th) that two new individual stock default deliveries have been reported on the over‑the‑counter market, involving test‑interface high‑priced stock Wan‑Silicon (6223‑TW) and solar‑panel manufacturer Cang‑He (6538‑TW), with a combined default amount of NT$65.021 million; these are the 17th and 18th default delivery cases recorded in the OTC market this year.

According to data released by the OTC Center, Wan‑Silicon’s default delivery amount reached NT$54.06 million, reported by three broker branches: Taiwan Bank Jinshan, Deshin, and Shin Kong; Cang‑He’s default amount was NT$10.961 million, reported by broker branches including Hua Nan Tainan, Yong‑Feng Chaozhou, and Yong‑Feng Taoyuan.

It is noteworthy that high‑priced stock Wan‑Silicon has already experienced a default delivery earlier this year. Looking back to June 12, Wan‑Silicon was reported by Yong‑Feng Securities’ Wansheng branch for a default delivery of NT$12.07 million; adding today’s reported NT$54.06 million brings Wan‑Silicon’s cumulative default delivery amount for the year to NT$66.13 million.

Based on Taiwan’s T+2 settlement system, the default deliveries reported on the 17th originated from trades executed on the 13th. Observing the market performance of the two stocks last Friday, both showed extreme volatility, which was the key trigger for the defaults.

On the 13th, Wan‑Silicon opened high at NT$4,910 and briefly surged to a peak of NT$5,100, but then faced heavy selling pressure, pulling back sharply to a low of NT$4,630—a price swing of over 10%. It closed with a modest gain of NT$15 at NT$4,670, up 0.32%. Cang‑He also opened high and fell, starting at NT$337, reaching a high of NT$338 before reversing sharply, plunging to the daily limit down price of NT$293.5 and staying there until the close, a drop of NT$32.5 or 9.97%.

Market analysts say that both stocks exhibited a “open high, close low” rapid decline on the day, catching investors who chased the rally or engaged in day‑trading long positions off guard; lacking sufficient settlement funds, they triggered large default deliveries today.

Investors are reminded that when trading securities, they should carefully assess their own financial condition and settlement capability, avoid over‑extending credit for high‑leverage or day‑trading activities, and ensure they can meet settlement obligations to prevent credit damage and related legal liabilities.

items.title: 工業電腦族群／瑞祺電通(6416)前三季EPS達5.4元超越去年全年法人看好明年挑戰8元以上
paras: 2026年11月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 工業電腦與網通設備廠瑞祺電通(6416-TW)前三季每股純益達5.40元，不僅高於去年同期的2.91元，也超過去年全年的4.30元。公司表示，未來三年成長將主要來自高毛利產品比重提高，以及今年併購的Network Box業務擴大。
瑞祺電通前三季營收為40.97億元，年增31%；營業毛利為10.11億元，年增38%，毛利率24.67%，較去年同期提高1.28個百分點。營業利益為5.04億元，年增91%；歸屬母公司淨利為3.96億元，年增86%。
公司預期，2027年至2028年高毛利產品的營收比重將逐年提高。目前Network Box約占合併營收6%，未來占比有望逐步提升至10%、12%及15%。法人預估，瑞祺電通今年每股純益有機會首度達到7元，2027年可望續創新高來到每股8元以上。
工業電腦產業目前面臨需求與供應不同步的情況。研華(2395-TW)第三季接單出貨比為1.64，10月仍達1.60，未交訂單約25億美元；不過，CPU、記憶體等零組件的供應與交期，仍影響到廠商出貨節奏。接單出貨比高於1，代表當期接單金額高於出貨金額，但不等於所有訂單都能立即轉為營收。
記憶體漲價也會改變產品成本結構。根據優分析彙編分析師預估共識，這兩家公司的營收今年以來都遠超過法人預期，但部分成長可能來自廠商將上漲的零組件成本轉嫁給客戶。由於這部分增加的銷售金額不一定帶來相同比例的利潤，營收優於預期，不代表獲利也會同步超標。後續仍須觀察各家廠商的料源取得、售價調整能力，以及高附加價值產品的比重。

items.title: 銀行甩賣AI資料中心債務！ING、法興尋求出售8億美元貸款、甲骨文3大項目遭波及
paras: 隨著銀行業日益警惕對人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的集中曝險，部分金融機構開始出售相關貸款，降低資產負債表風險。荷蘭ING銀行與法國興業銀行近期合計尋求出售最多8億美元的資料中心債務，涉及多個與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 相關的建設項目，顯示銀行業正逐步釋出AI投資熱潮累積的信用風險。
根據《金融時報》週二（17日）報導，知情人士透露，相關貸款出售行動已持續數月，但美國期中選舉後，民主黨大勝加深市場對美國資料中心監管可能收緊的疑慮，促使銀行加快在年底前整理資產負債表。
此外，英國央行與歐洲央行也相繼啟動對銀行資料中心貸款曝險的審查，進一步增加金融機構的監管壓力。
從貸款報價來看，部分資產仍高於面額的90美分，顯示整體信用品質尚未出現明顯惡化。不過，涉及美國新墨西哥州、因電力供應受阻而面臨延誤的資料中心項目，貸款預估成交價格可能降至面額的85美分左右，反映個別建設計畫已出現實質風險。

ING出售5億美元貸款　法興尋求出清3億美元債務

知情人士表示，ING銀行目前拍賣的貸款規模約5億美元，借款方包括資料中心營運商CyrusOne(CONE-US) 、EdgeConnex及Vantage Data Centres，以及甲骨文在新墨西哥州支持的Project Jupiter。
其中，Project Jupiter目前因電力許可證審批延誤面臨進度問題，甲骨文已針對此事發出不可抗力通知。
法國興業銀行則尋求出售約3億美元的專案融資債務，涉及甲骨文在威斯康辛州的Project Lighthouse，以及德州的Project Frontier。
Project Jupiter、Project Lighthouse以及Project Frontier去年合計向數十家銀行籌集超過560億美元的建設債務。
貸款定價方面，威斯康辛州及德州項目的相關貸款報價仍高於面額90美分。知情人士表示，這波出售主要是投資組合管理操作，並非銀行急於避開信用品質惡化的資產。
相較之下，新墨西哥州項目的貸款預估成交價格約為面額85美分，顯示電力許可延誤已為該項目帶來額外不確定性。

AI融資曝險過度集中　銀行尋求降低風險

知情人士指出，銀行業對AI資料中心債務的疑慮已累積數月，主要問題在於金融機構對少數大型科技公司及尖端AI實驗室的曝險過度集中。
Nuveen全球能源基礎設施信貸主管Don Dimitrievich指出，AI基礎設施所需的資本規模，以任何標準衡量都已創下歷史紀錄，甚至超出傳統資金來源的承受能力。他表示，許多金融機構的風險長已明確要求縮減相關投資組合。
Dimitrievich也指出，近期貸款出售活動提供了較有利的融資條件與更具吸引力的報酬，原因包括部分貸款機構重新評估風險，以及監管資本限制。
律師事務所Linklaters紐約結構性融資合夥人David Lucking表示，銀行持有這類債務的資本效率較低，無論是資本要求、風險限額或內部資產負債表管理，都促使銀行尋找其他方式，以便在控制風險的同時繼續放貸。
除了直接出售貸款，銀行也開始透過信用保險及風險移轉交易管理曝險，並愈來愈常採用144A架構，讓債務能出售給更廣泛的機構投資人。
144A債券是依照美國《1933年證券法》第144A條發行的私募債券，允許發行人向合格機構投資人進行私募，不必經過美國證券交易委員會（SEC）繁複的公開註冊程序。
知情人士透露，Anthropic規模630億美元的債務融資方案，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 為購買AI晶片安排的400億美元融資，預計都將在未來幾個月進入144A債券市場交易。
值得注意的是，部分主要貸款機構已退出Anthropic的融資交易，原因正是擔憂對該AI實驗室的曝險過度集中，反映銀行業對AI相關融資的風險控管正在收緊。

保密條款增加避險難度　英歐監管機構同步調查

除了降低貸款曝險，銀行也面臨另一項風險管理難題。部分資料中心貸款合約設有保密條款，禁止貸款機構參與需要共享貸款資訊的第三方交易，包括信用違約交換（CDS）及合成風險移轉工具，使銀行難以透過一般衍生性金融商品對沖相關風險。
Lucking表示，如果這類限制在市場上愈來愈普遍，將為金融機構帶來相當大的問題。
與此同時，歐洲監管機構也正加強對資料中心融資的審查。知情人士透露，英國央行正向英國各銀行索取資料中心項目貸款的詳細資訊，作為例行監管工作的一部分。
歐洲央行則已啟動監管審查，評估歐元區銀行對資料中心融資的曝險程度及風險管理方式，相關計畫最早於10月底與銀行高層的會議中討論。

items.title: 黃仁勳打破沉默！認了犯錯、願回任輝達 決定權交董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Breaks Silence, Acknowledges Mistakes and Offers to Return as Nvidia CEO if Board Approves
paras: 綜合外媒周二(17日)報導，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳離任後首次發布公開聲明，表態若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，他願意回任執行長。他也承認個人生活犯下嚴重錯誤，承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。
黃仁勳表示，離任後收到許多員工、投資人、合作夥伴及客戶呼籲他回任的聲音。
他說：「如果董事會認為，我的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，我將很榮幸回應這些呼聲，重新擔任執行長。」
對於引發離任的風波，黃仁勳坦言，自己未能達到輝達對所有人的要求，並在個人生活中犯下嚴重錯誤。
他說：「我為董事會帶來了問題，對此深感懊悔。我完全承擔自己的錯誤，並承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。」
黃仁勳上周因婚外情風波辭職，結束33年的執行長任期。輝達已委託 Wachtell Lipton 律師事務所，調查他的行為是否危及國家安全或公司機密，包括他與疑涉中國情報活動的黃樂(Alice Huang)之間的關係。
呼籲黃仁勳回任的網路連署已獲逾18萬人支持，馬斯克等科技業人士也加入聲援。美國總統川普周一表示，不反對黃仁勳重新擔任輝達執行長，並認為他已「學到很大的教訓」。
《華爾街日報》另披露，輝達開發者技術主管 Nader Khalil 周一致函董事長瓊斯(Harvey Jones)，呼籲讓黃仁勳回歸。他在信中表示，相信公司終有一天能找到接班人，但不能倉促進行交接，未來幾年的關鍵時期仍需要黃仁勳領導。
不過，《CNBC》與《華爾街日報》均報導，董事會並未考慮讓黃仁勳回任。輝達董事會上周五表示，正挑選協助尋找新執行長的人才招募公司，並於周二宣布成立新委員會，監督國家安全政策與出口管制遵循情況。

黃仁勳聲明全文


過去一周，朋友、業界同仁，以及素未謀面的人們給予的關愛與支持，讓我深受感動。感謝每一位善待我和家人的人，這對我意義重大。
我在53年前來到美國，成為美國公民，是我人生中最珍貴的禮物之一，也是最引以為傲的時刻之一。輝達是我畢生的心血。能與同事們一起，將它打造為今天這樣的公司，是我的榮幸。只有在美國，才有可能誕生像輝達這樣的公司。我愛我們的國家，也愛輝達。
我未能達到輝達對每一個人的要求，也在個人生活中犯下了嚴重錯誤。我為董事會帶來了問題，對此深感懊悔。我完全承擔自己的錯誤，並承諾配合董事會的獨立調查。
自從離任以來，我看到輝達員工、投資人、合作夥伴與客戶，紛紛呼籲我回任執行長。在公司面對複雜的技術、市場、競爭與地緣政治局勢之際，許多人仍持續直接與我聯繫。輝達是一家一個世代才可能出現一次的公司。如果董事會認為，我的回歸符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最佳利益，我將很榮幸回應這些呼聲，重新擔任執行長。
再次感謝所有向我表達祝福的人。你們的支持，讓我深感謙卑。
致我的家人：我愛你們，我會用餘生努力，讓自己值得你們的愛。
paras_en: Comprehensive foreign media reports on Tuesday (the 17th) said that Jensen Huang, former CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), issued his first public statement since stepping down, indicating that he would be willing to resume the CEO role if the board believes his return serves the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, and he also admitted serious personal mistakes and pledged to cooperate with an independent board investigation.
Huang said that after his departure he received many calls from employees, investors, partners and customers urging him to return.

He said: “If the board believes my return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, I would be honored to answer those calls and resume the CEO position.”
Regarding the controversy that led to his resignation, Huang candidly admitted that he failed to meet Nvidia’s expectations of everyone and made serious personal errors.
He said: “I have caused problems for the board and deeply regret it. I fully own my mistakes and commit to cooperating with the board’s independent investigation.”

Huang resigned last week amid an extramarital affair scandal, ending a 33‑year tenure as CEO. Nvidia has hired the law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate whether his conduct jeopardized national security or company secrets, including his relationship with Alice Huang, who is suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence activities.

A petition calling for Huang’s return has gathered over 180,000 signatures, with tech figures such as Elon Musk joining the support. Former President Donald Trump said on Monday he does not oppose Huang resuming the Nvidia CEO role and believes Huang has “learned a big lesson.”

The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia’s senior developer technology officer Nader Khalil sent a letter to chairman Harvey Jones on Monday urging Huang’s comeback, stating he believes the company will eventually find a successor but cannot rush the transition and that the critical coming years still require Huang’s leadership.

However, both CNBC and the Wall Street Journal reported that the board is not considering Huang’s return. Nvidia’s board said last Friday it is selecting a talent‑search firm to help find a new CEO and announced on Tuesday the creation of a new committee to oversee national‑security policy and export‑control compliance.

Full text of Huang’s statement

Over the past week, the care and support from friends, industry colleagues and even strangers have moved me deeply. I thank everyone who has treated my family and me kindly; it means a great deal to me.

I came to the United States 53 years ago and became a citizen – one of the most precious gifts of my life and a source of great pride. Nvidia is the work of my whole life. It has been an honor to build it with my colleagues into the company it is today. Only in America could a company like Nvidia be born. I love our country and I love Nvidia.

I failed to meet Nvidia’s expectations of every individual and made serious personal mistakes. I caused problems for the board and deeply regret it. I fully own my mistakes and commit to cooperating with the board’s independent investigation.

Since stepping down, I have heard Nvidia employees, investors, partners and customers repeatedly urging me to return as CEO. As the company faces complex technical, market, competitive and geopolitical challenges, many continue to reach out to me directly. Nvidia is a once‑in‑a‑generation company. If the board believes my return serves the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company and the United States, I would be honored to answer those calls and resume the CEO role.
Thank you again to everyone who has sent me well‑wishes. Your support makes me feel humbled.
To my family: I love you and will spend the rest of my life working to be worthy of your love.

items.title: AI燒錢不愁金主的時代結束了？輝達風波敲響警鐘
items.title_en: Is the Era of AI Burning Cash Without Worrying About Backers Over? Nvidia Turmoil Sounds the Alarm
paras: 據《路透》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)領導層動盪，正讓支撐 AI 產業快速擴張的寬裕融資環境面臨考驗。投資人擔憂，黃仁勳離任後，接班人可能收緊對合作夥伴的融資與擔保支持，使高度依賴舉債的新興雲端業者承受更大壓力，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)已出現股債雙跌。
過去幾年，輝達透過投資、供應商融資與擔保等方式，協助基礎設施業者擴張。如今接班人選未定，市場開始重新評估，這些企業未來還能獲得多少資金支持。

新興雲端股債雙殺 融資壓力浮現

CoreWeave、Nebius 等「新興雲端業者」(neocloud)，主要採購繪圖處理器(GPU)，再將算力出租給 AI 開發商、新創及大型科技企業。這些公司財務規模相對有限，卻須投入鉅資購買晶片、興建資料中心，因此高度依賴外部融資。
CoreWeave 今年6月以9.625%殖利率發行的債券，近期價格重挫，殖利率攀升至接近15%；自那斯達克指數10月6日創下最近一次歷史新高以來，股價已下跌45%。
公司上周表示，仍可透過以晶片抵押借款等方式取得資金。輝達除了持有其股份，也依據63億美元訂單，承諾在2032年4月前承購未售出的雲端算力。
Nebius 今年8月以4.5%殖利率發行的可轉換公司債，上周五跌至面額的70%，殖利率升破12%；股價自10月6日以來下跌57%。輝達今年3月曾宣布投資20億美元，取得該公司8.3%股權。

既有承諾料不變 接班人是否繼續支持成關鍵

惠靈頓資產管理固定收益投資組合經理 Loren Moran 表示，無論誰接任，在運用輝達資產負債表承擔風險時，都可能比黃仁勳保守，財務較弱業者能取得的融資恐因此減少。
Impax Asset Management 投資級債券投資組合經理 Tony Trzcinka 則指出，黃仁勳離任應不會改變既有合約與擔保，關鍵在於接班人是否願意繼續積極參與各種融資安排。
對輝達而言，降低風險承擔可能有利信用體質；但仰賴其直接或間接支持的企業，未來資金可能更難取得，成本也可能提高。
相較之下，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)等大型雲端業者財務較強，能透過內部現金流與債市籌資支應建設，更有能力因應融資環境轉變。

高收益債交易降溫 資金開始挑選贏家

高盛(GS-US)全球槓桿融資主管 Miriam Wheeler 指出，市場擔憂債券供給增加與政治不確定性，近幾周 AI 相關高收益債交易已明顯放緩。
市場原先預期，今年秋季相關發行規模約600億美元，一度對信用利差形成壓力；但自9月底起，供給急遽萎縮，過去一個月更沒有新交易。
Trzcinka 表示，若資料中心仍在興建，借款企業又屬高收益債等級，資金成本就會明顯提高。
TwentyFour Asset Management 投資組合經理 Danny Zaid 認為，產業不確定性升高，投資人將要求更高風險溢價，並逐一檢視企業信用體質。這意味著，即使 AI 需求持續成長，也不代表所有業者都能以相同條件取得資金，企業間的融資待遇差距將進一步擴大。
paras_en: According to Reuters, turmoil among Nvidia (NVDA-US) leadership is putting the generous financing environment that has underpinned the rapid expansion of the AI industry to the test. Investors fear that after Jensen Huang steps down, his successor may tighten financing and guarantee support for partners, increasing pressure on highly leveraged emerging cloud providers; CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Nebius (NBIS-US) have already seen both their stocks and bonds fall.

In recent years Nvidia helped infrastructure players expand through investments, supplier financing and guarantees. With a successor still undecided, the market is re‑evaluating how much funding these companies can expect in the future.

Emerging cloud stocks and bonds are being hit as financing pressure surfaces. Companies such as CoreWeave and Nebius – the so‑called “neocloud” players – mainly purchase GPUs and then lease compute capacity to AI developers, startups and large tech firms. Their financial scale is relatively limited, yet they must spend heavily on chips and data‑center construction, making them highly dependent on external financing.

CoreWeave’s bonds issued in June this year at a 9.625% yield have recently slumped in price, pushing the yield up toward 15%; since the Nasdaq index hit a recent high on October 6, the stock has fallen 45%.

The company said last week it can still raise cash by borrowing against its chip inventory. Nvidia, besides holding shares, has committed, based on a $6.3 billion order, to purchase any unsold cloud compute capacity by April 2032.

Nebius’s convertible bonds issued in August at a 4.5% yield fell to 70% of par last Friday, with the yield climbing above 12%; the stock has dropped 57% since October 6. Nvidia announced in March that it would invest $2 billion to acquire an 8.3% stake in the firm.

Existing commitments remain unchanged; whether the successor continues support is the key. Loren Moran, fixed‑income portfolio manager at Wellington Management, said that whoever takes over may be less conservative than Jensen Huang in using Nvidia’s balance sheet to assume risk, potentially reducing financing available to financially weaker firms.

Tony Trzcinka, investment‑grade bond portfolio manager at Impax Asset Management, noted that Jensen Huang’s departure should not alter existing contracts and guarantees; the crucial factor is whether the successor is willing to stay actively involved in various financing arrangements.
For Nvidia, reducing risk exposure could improve its credit profile; however, companies that rely on its direct or indirect support may find funding harder to obtain and more costly in the future.

By contrast, large cloud providers such as Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US) have stronger finances and can fund construction through internal cash flow and the bond market, giving them greater ability to cope with a shifting financing environment.

High‑yield bond trading has cooled as investors begin to pick winners. Miriam Wheeler, global leveraged finance head at Goldman Sachs (GS-US), said the market is worried about increased bond supply and political uncertainty, and AI‑related high‑yield trading has noticeably slowed in recent weeks.

The market had originally expected about $60 billion of related issuances this fall, which at one point put pressure on credit spreads; but since the end of September supply has sharply contracted, and there have been no new deals in the past month.
Trzcinka added that if data‑centers are still being built and borrowing firms are high‑yield borrowers, financing costs will rise sharply.

Danny Zaid, portfolio manager at TwentyFour Asset Management, believes rising industry uncertainty will lead investors to demand higher risk premiums and scrutinize each company’s credit quality. This means that even if AI demand continues to grow, not all players will secure funding on the same terms, and financing gaps between firms will widen further.

items.title: 黃仁勳12月1日赴美國會！眾院三委員會追查輝達國安疑慮
items.title_en: Jensen Huang to Appear Before U.S. Congress on Dec. 1; House Panels Probe Nvidia National‑Security Concerns
paras: 綜合外媒周二(17日)報導，輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳已同意於12月1日，出席美國眾議院外交、情報及中國問題特別委員會的聯席會議，說明他與疑似中國間諜女子的關係，以及公司安全管理與出口管制相關問題。輝達法務長泰德(Tim Teter)則將於12月2日出席。
議員表示，兩場訪談將製作逐字紀錄，預計以閉門方式進行。此外，參議院銀行委員會也已要求黃仁勳於12月3日出席公開聽證會，顯示國會對輝達的調查壓力持續升高。

傳票壓力下接受邀請 國會追問晶片流向與機密接觸

《彭博》指出，眾院外交委員會主席馬斯特(Brian Mast)與中國問題特別委員會主席穆勒納爾(John Moolenaar)，上周曾表明可能發出傳票，要求黃仁勳出席，黃仁勳隨後接受邀請。
馬斯特、穆勒納爾與情報委員會主席克勞福(Rick Crawford)在聯合聲明中表示：「我們期待聽取黃仁勳與泰德說明，他們在這起可能危及美國國家安全的事件中所扮演的角色。」
三位主席並表示，美國民眾需要了解，黃仁勳與輝達在讓被他們視為具有威脅的中國人士取得美國最先進晶片一事中，扮演何種角色，以及一名疑似中國情報人員在風波中的涉入情況。
黃仁勳上周因婚外情風波辭職。涉事女子黃樂(Alice Huang)曾任新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed International 高層，被美國情報單位懷疑是中國間諜。輝達曾向 Megaspeed 出售晶片，華府擔憂部分晶片可能遭非法轉運至中國。
Megaspeed 因可能違反出口管制而受到美方調查，公司否認有任何不法行為。《彭博》報導，黃樂目前人在中國。
穆勒納爾15日接受《CBS》節目訪問時表示，國會希望釐清機密資訊可能遭接觸的程度，以及黃樂是否影響輝達推動有利中國持續取得晶片的政策立場。

法務長通話受檢視 參院另要求黃仁勳公開作證

泰德也將被要求說明輝達遵守出口管制的情況，以及議員所稱公司干預美國出口管制政策與調查的相關報導。
《彭博》先前披露，泰德曾於2025年夏末致電美國商務部負責執行出口管制的單位主管，詢問該機關是否參與黃樂遭新加坡當局拘留一事。
輝達對此回應，公司經常與政府官員聯繫，以回答問題並提供資訊。針對此次國會聯合聲明，黃仁勳與輝達的發言人均未立即回應；輝達周一則曾表示：「我們期待於12月2日與各委員會主席會面。」
輝達董事會已就黃仁勳與黃樂的關係展開內部調查，但也表示，目前不認為國家安全或公司機密受到損害。美國聯邦執法機關則正在進行間諜活動調查，另有可能涉及晶片走私的調查持續進行。
參院銀行委員會主席史考特(Tim Scott)已要求黃仁勳12月3日出席公開聽證會，並要求商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)於12月10日作證。這些要求與黃仁勳已同意的眾院出席安排不同，目前報導尚未確認他是否接受參院邀請。
這場風波也加強了兩黨議員將晶片出口管制措施納入年底前須通過的國防法案的力道。將於明年1月掌控參眾兩院的民主黨議員，已承諾進一步檢視黃仁勳、輝達及其他矽谷企業，相關國會調查可能持續延燒。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Tuesday the 17th, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) former chief executive Jensen Huang has agreed to attend a joint hearing of the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China‑Specific Subcommittees on Dec. 1, where he will address his relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy and issues related to the company’s security management and export controls. Nvidia’s general counsel Tim Teter will appear on Dec. 2.

Lawmakers said both interviews will be transcribed verbatim and are expected to be held behind closed doors. In addition, the Senate Banking Committee has asked Huang to appear at a public hearing on Dec. 3, indicating that congressional pressure on Nvidia continues to mount.

Under subpoena pressure, Huang accepted the invitation as Congress presses for details on chip shipments and confidential contacts. Bloomberg noted that House Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast and China‑Specific Subcommittee Chair John Moolenaar indicated last week that they might issue a subpoena for Huang, who then accepted the invitation.

Mast, Moolenaar and Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford said in a joint statement, “We look forward to hearing from Jensen Huang and Tim Teter about the role they played in this matter that could threaten U.S. national security.”

The three chairs added that the American public needs to understand what role Huang and Nvidia played in allowing individuals they deem a threat from China to obtain the United States’ most advanced chips, and the extent of involvement by a suspected Chinese intelligence operative in the controversy.

Huang stepped down last week amid an extramarital‑affair scandal. The woman involved, Alice Huang, formerly a senior executive at Singapore‑based tech firm Megaspeed International, is suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy. Nvidia had sold chips to Megaspeed, and Washington worries some of those chips may have been illegally rerouted to China.
Megaspeed is under U.S. investigation for possible export‑control violations, which the company denies. Bloomberg reports that Alice Huang is currently in China.

In a CBS interview on the 15th, Moolenaar said Congress wants to clarify how much classified information may have been accessed and whether Alice Huang influenced Nvidia’s policy stance that facilitates China’s continued chip acquisition.

General counsel Tim Teter will also be asked to explain Nvidia’s compliance with export controls and the lawmakers’ allegations that the company interfered with U.S. export‑control policy and investigations.

Bloomberg previously disclosed that Teter called the head of the Commerce Department’s export‑control enforcement unit in late summer 2025 to ask whether the agency was involved in Alice Huang’s detention by Singaporean authorities.

Nvidia responded that the company regularly contacts government officials to answer questions and provide information. Neither Huang nor Nvidia’s spokesperson immediately responded to the joint House statement; on Monday Nvidia said, “We look forward to meeting the committee chairs on Dec. 2.”

The board has launched an internal investigation into Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang but says it does not currently believe national‑security or corporate‑confidential information has been compromised. Federal law‑enforcement agencies are probing espionage activities, and a separate investigation into possible chip smuggling continues.

Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott has asked Huang to appear at a public hearing on Dec. 3 and has requested Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify on Dec. 10. These requests differ from the House appearance Huang has already agreed to, and reports have not confirmed whether he will accept the Senate invitation.

The episode has bolstered bipartisan efforts to embed chip‑export‑control measures in a defense bill that must pass before the end of the year. Democrats who will control both chambers in January have pledged to further scrutinize Huang, Nvidia and other Silicon Valley firms, suggesting the congressional probe could keep escalating.

items.title: 《大賣空》艾斯曼示警！輝達風波延燒 AI新興雲端股「麻煩大了」
paras: 據《CNBC》報導，電影《大賣空》角色原型之一、知名投資人艾斯曼(Steve Eisman)警告，輝達(NVDA-US)風波可能讓仰賴借款擴張的 AI 新興雲端業者成為最大輸家。相較之下，若資料中心建設適度放緩，他更看好大型雲端業者，認為其現金流有望改善。

輝達融資支持恐縮手 新興雲端股承壓

艾斯曼在《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」中，將輝達及其合作網絡形容為一個「實質上的垂直整合控股體系」，並認為這個體系正在瓦解。
他說：「我認為新興雲端業者都麻煩大了，因為它們是這個體系的一部分，而我認為它們即將被排除在外。」
這類業者主要透過借款興建資料中心，出租 AI 算力，在近期 AI 類股回檔中受創尤其嚴重。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)與 Nebius(NBIS-US)過去三個月股價均下跌逾50%。
輝達即將於周二盤後公布財報，同時面對黃仁勳因與一名據稱被美國情報單位懷疑是中國間諜的女子發生婚外情而離任的風波。美國商務部也已採取措施，收緊中國遠端使用資料中心的管道。
投資人擔心，隨著輝達中國相關營收受到更嚴格檢視，公司可能縮減支撐 AI 產業擴張的大規模融資安排。

建設限制比IPO更關鍵 艾斯曼偏好大型雲端商

對於預計周四上市的 Anthropic，艾斯曼認為，市場期待已經降溫，這場備受矚目的首次公開發行(IPO)，對 AI 投資行情的重要性也隨之下降。
他說：「我認為已經沒什麼人在意了。」
他更關注民主黨明年1月掌控國會並接掌多州州長職位後，地方與州政府將在多大程度上限制資料中心建設。
艾斯曼提出兩種假設。他表示，若全面暫停興建資料中心，可能迅速使美國陷入衰退；若建設僅放緩10%至30%，他最看好的則是大型雲端業者。
他說：「最受惠的族群是大型雲端業者，因為它們的現金流會重新轉正。」
這項判斷建立在建設適度放緩的情境上。相較於高度依賴融資的新興雲端業者，艾斯曼認為，大型雲端業者有機會因建設支出減少而改善現金流。

items.title: 輝達面臨的挑戰不止於黃仁勳離職！摩根大通示警「兩大成長」引擎承壓
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 面臨的挑戰，可能不只執行長黃仁勳離任所帶來的管理層變動，人工智慧（AI）晶片市場競爭加劇，以及開源模型生態系面臨的美國出口管制，也正對公司長期成長動能構成壓力。
摩根大通策略師Michael Cembalest在最新研究報告《輝達與AI的下一步》中指出，尖端AI實驗室正逐步分散算力採購來源，將訂單轉向超微半導體(AMD-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 等競爭對手。預計於2026年後部署的算力協議，輝達GPU僅占28%。
另一方面，開源模型生態系也面臨美國政府監管壓力。這兩項發展分別牽動輝達的AI晶片定價能力，以及開源市場需求，可能動搖過去支撐公司高估值的兩大成長引擎。
Cembalest認為，市場競爭格局的變化，對投資人的重要性在某種程度上不亞於管理層變動，甚至可能更加深遠。

AI算力採購分散　輝達協議占比僅28%

Cembalest統計主要尖端AI實驗室已公布、預計於2026年後部署的算力協議，總規模約44吉瓦（GW），其中採用輝達GPU的算力約12.1GW，占比僅28%。
其餘算力來源包括博通(AVGO-US) 客製化晶片，占23%；超微半導體 占18%；亞馬遜Trainium占16%；Google TPU占14%；Cerebras(CBRS-US) 則占2%。
這與輝達在2024至2025年間占據AI晶片營收80%至90%的市場地位形成鮮明對比。
在七大AI加速晶片採購業者中，除了SpaceX(SPCX-US) 尚未推進自研晶片計畫，其餘業者都已設法發展替代方案，以降低對輝達GPU的依賴，並避開其高達75%的毛利率所反映的成本壓力。
這股趨勢早已浮現。2025年10月，OpenAI與超微半導體簽署多吉瓦規模的算力協議，消息公布當天，超微半導體股價創下近十年來最大單日漲幅。

CUDA生態系優勢鬆動　晶片轉移時間大幅縮短

輝達長期以來的重要競爭壁壘，是CUDA軟體生態系。由於客戶若要從輝達平台轉換至其他硬體，需要投入大量工程資源與時間，因此過去不容易轉移。
但Cembalest引述與一家尖端AI實驗室的交流指出，AI工具正在降低轉換門檻。一年前，將模型移植至超微半導體 GPU需要6至12個月，過程繁瑣且工程成本高昂；如今透過最新AI模型協助工程作業，新模型移植至超微半導體 GPU只需約3天。
硬體效能方面，Epoch AI的推論基準測試顯示，超微半導體 MI455X的綜合評分約為輝達GB300的2.9倍，也高於輝達自家Vera Rubin VR200約2.2倍的評分。
此外，Google TPU7x在每美元算力指標上，除了最低速區間之外，也全面領先輝達GB300 NVL72。
Cembalest也承認，輝達預計於2027年推出的Rubin Ultra可能改變目前的競爭局面，但在AI晶片市場快速演變之際，這段等待時間仍可能讓競爭對手持續擴大優勢。

開源模型市場面臨出口管制　輝達海外營收受關注

除了晶片市場競爭，開源模型生態系也是輝達的重要客戶群體。Cembalest指出，開源權重模型社群是輝達的核心市場之一，這些模型在OpenRouter平台消耗了大部分推論算力，能力也持續追近閉源尖端模型。
然而，開源模型市場正面臨美國出口管制帶來的不確定性。SemiAnalysis估計，已有約1.5GW受限制的輝達晶片流入海外市場，並指出輝達是相關供應鏈的重要一環，無論是否出於主動。
Cembalest也援引數據指出，美國拜登政府實施出口管制後，輝達來自新加坡地址的營收占比，已從8%升至22%；輝達則從2025年7月起停止單獨揭露這項數據。
高盛分析師Jim Schneider上周五也警告，輝達在特定司法管轄區的營運可能面臨更多審查。
Cembalest並引用前Stratechery撰稿人Andrew Sharp的評論，指出輝達在享有美國市場、法律制度及客戶帶來的利益之際，其行事方式卻不像一家對美國政府負責的美國企業。

估值具吸引力　但獲利成長預期面臨考驗

儘管提出多項風險，Cembalest並未因此看空輝達。他指出，輝達在2023至2025年間取得AI晶片市場83%的營收，毛利率高達75%，且晶片設計週期漫長。
以估值來看，輝達股價較歷史高點下跌32%，本益成長比（PEG）僅0.2倍。Cembalest認為，對長期投資人而言，輝達仍具吸引力，也是大型AI類股中估值最低的標的。
不過，0.2倍的PEG建立在市場共識預期的獲利成長能夠實現的前提上，而這項預期正面臨兩大挑戰：尖端AI實驗室加快採購競爭對手的晶片，開源模型買家則可能必須取得許可證，才能繼續採購相關產品。
Cembalest總結，輝達面臨的不只有管理層變動，AI晶片市場競爭加劇，以及開源模型市場受到監管，同樣是值得警惕的風險。

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI股能否翻身？主要指數漲跌互現 市場屏息等輝達財報
paras: 美股主要指數周二(17日)開盤走勢不一，道瓊工業指數受家得寶(HD-US)財報拖累下跌，那斯達克指數開高後震盪，盤初在晶片股支撐下徘徊平盤附近。投資人聚焦輝達(NVDA-US)盤後財報，盼從最新業績與財測，尋找AI需求及科技股後市的方向。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近330點或近0.6%，那斯達克綜合指數跌0.06%，標普 500 指數跌近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近0.7%，台積電ADR跌逾1.0%。
美股賣壓周二出現緩和跡象，跌深科技股吸引買盤回流，投資人將焦點轉向輝達(NVDA-US)盤後財報，尋找 AI 產業前景的關鍵線索。不過，美國10月零售銷售優於預期，強化市場對下月升息的預期，美債回吐稍早漲幅。
那斯達克100指數期貨上漲0.3%，此前該指數連續兩個交易日重挫，累計跌幅達6%；標普500指數期貨則下跌0.1%。輝達盤前上漲0.9%，晶片股同步走揚，布蘭特原油價格升破每桶93美元。

輝達財報成AI信心考驗 強勁業績未必足以救市

輝達即將公布財報之際，正面臨黃仁勳離任引發的重大動盪。除了季度業績與財測，市場也希望確認，新領導團隊能否延續合作夥伴關係，並讓產品開發計畫如期推進。
瑞訊銀行分析師 Ipek Ozkardeskaya 表示，投資人將仔細檢視營收成長、利潤率、客戶承諾，以及輝達對中國市場的曝險，包括出口管制收緊帶來的影響。輝達稍早已宣布，成立新的董事會委員會，監督國家安全與出口管制事務。
盛寶銀行英國策略師 Neil Wilson 預期，輝達財報將非常強勁，但強勁業績未必足以支撐市場，因為目前還有太多其他因素同時影響投資情緒。
美國限制中國取得先進 AI 晶片與伺服器的新措施，也讓亞洲市場承壓。MSCI 亞太指數下跌1.5%，科技股成為主要拖累，台股加權指數下跌2.3%，南韓 Kospi 指數則下跌2.6%。

基金大砍科技股部位 零售強勁削弱美債避險效果

AI 樂觀情緒降溫之際，基金經理人也大幅降低科技股配置。美國銀行(BAC-US)於11月6日至12日進行的調查顯示，基金經理人對科技股的淨加碼比率，從10月的37%降至12%，減碼幅度為20年來最大。
不過，市場仍有逢低布局的聲音。Jefferies(JEF-US)策略師 Mohit Kumar 表示，並不擔心 AI 投資主題偏離成長軌道，但一直建議分散配置。隨著部分個股估值開始具有吸引力，近期跌勢也帶來買進機會。
傳統避險資產則未見明顯買盤。美國零售銷售優於預期，支持經濟需求仍強的看法，也強化聯準會(Fed)下月升息的理由，美債因此回吐漲幅，黃金與美元變動不大。
駿利亨德森(JHG-US)投資組合經理 Oliver Blackbourn 表示，目前要尋找避險去處並不容易，強勁成長與通膨使美債難以發揮往常的保護作用。不過，以目前殖利率水準而言，美債在投資組合中的避險潛力，已較過去很長一段時間改善。
歐洲股市同樣承壓，Stoxx 600指數出現逾一周最大跌幅。德意志銀行(DB-US)則因《金融時報》報導其曾處理與艾普斯坦(Jeffrey Epstein)有關的可疑款項，股價下跌逾4%。

items.title: 美國消費還撐得住！10月零售銷售增0.2% 核心數據優於預期
items.title_en: U.S. Consumer Spending Still Holds Up! October Retail Sales Up 0.2% – Core Data Beats Expectations
paras: 美國10月零售銷售月增0.2%，增幅較9月放緩，但用於估算國內生產毛額(GDP)消費支出的控制組銷售優於預期，顯示商品需求仍有韌性。通膨侵蝕購買力之際，消費尚未明顯降溫，也使聯準會(Fed)面臨需求與物價壓力並存的局面。
美國商務部周二(17日)公布，10月零售銷售月增0.2%，符合經濟學家預期，9月增幅維持0.8%不變。排除汽車與汽油後，銷售成長0.5%。這項數據未經通膨調整，金額增加也可能反映價格上漲。
更受市場關注的控制組銷售，排除汽車、汽油、建材與餐飲服務後，10月月增0.6%，優於預估的0.4%；9月增幅也從0.1%上修至0.5%，顯示第四季初的消費動能仍有支撐。
13個零售類別中，7類銷售增加，非店面零售、健康與個人照護用品、加油站及建材商表現較佳，汽車、家具與嗜好用品則下滑，反映民眾對部分大額支出轉趨謹慎。
不過，消費韌性背後仍有壓力。美以與伊朗的戰事推升物價，家庭9月經通膨及稅負調整後的可支配所得下滑0.3%，儲蓄率也降至近四年低點。經濟學家指出，更多家庭仰賴信用卡或動用積蓄維持支出，近期科技股下跌也可能削弱高所得家庭的消費意願。
對Fed而言，控制組銷售強於預期，顯示需求仍具韌性，但實質所得下滑與信用依賴升高，也透露家庭財務承壓。這份數據為利率決策提供了消費面的線索，後續仍須搭配通膨與就業表現，判斷物價壓力及經濟承受能力。
paras_en: U.S. October retail sales rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, a slower pace than September, but the core‑goods sales used to estimate consumer spending in GDP came in stronger than expected, indicating that demand for goods remains resilient. Even as inflation erodes purchasing power, consumption has not cooled noticeably, leaving the Federal Reserve facing a mix of demand and price pressures.

The U.S. Department of Commerce announced on Tuesday (the 17th) that October retail sales increased 0.2% month‑over‑month, in line with economists’ forecasts, while September’s gain held steady at 0.8%. Excluding autos and gasoline, sales grew 0.5%. The figure is not inflation‑adjusted, so the dollar increase may also reflect higher prices.

The more closely watched core sales figure – which strips out autos, gasoline, building materials and restaurant services – rose 0.6% in October, beating the 0.4% estimate; September’s core gain was revised up from 0.1% to 0.5%, showing that consumption momentum at the start of Q4 still has support.

Among 13 retail categories, sales rose in seven. Non‑store retail, health and personal care products, gas stations and building‑material merchants performed best, while autos, furniture and hobby goods slipped, reflecting more cautious spending on larger‑ticket items.

Nevertheless, the resilience in consumption masks underlying pressures. The war between the United States and Iran has pushed up prices, and after inflation and tax adjustments, households’ disposable income fell 0.3% in September, with the savings rate sliding to its lowest level in nearly four years. Economists note that more families are relying on credit cards or dipping into savings to maintain spending, and recent declines in tech stocks could dampen the spending appetite of high‑income households.

For the Fed, the stronger‑than‑expected core sales signal that demand remains robust, but the drop in real incomes and rising credit reliance reveal financial strain on households. This data provides a consumption‑side clue for rate‑setting, but future decisions will still need to weigh inflation and employment trends to gauge price pressures and the economy’s capacity to absorb them.

items.title: 銀行甩賣AI資料中心債務！ING、法興尋求出售8億美元貸款、甲骨文3大項目遭波及
paras: 隨著銀行業日益警惕對人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的集中曝險，部分金融機構開始出售相關貸款，降低資產負債表風險。荷蘭ING銀行與法國興業銀行近期合計尋求出售最多8億美元的資料中心債務，涉及多個與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 相關的建設項目，顯示銀行業正逐步釋出AI投資熱潮累積的信用風險。
根據《金融時報》週二（17日）報導，知情人士透露，相關貸款出售行動已持續數月，但美國期中選舉後，民主黨大勝加深市場對美國資料中心監管可能收緊的疑慮，促使銀行加快在年底前整理資產負債表。
此外，英國央行與歐洲央行也相繼啟動對銀行資料中心貸款曝險的審查，進一步增加金融機構的監管壓力。
從貸款報價來看，部分資產仍高於面額的90美分，顯示整體信用品質尚未出現明顯惡化。不過，涉及美國新墨西哥州、因電力供應受阻而面臨延誤的資料中心項目，貸款預估成交價格可能降至面額的85美分左右，反映個別建設計畫已出現實質風險。

ING出售5億美元貸款　法興尋求出清3億美元債務

知情人士表示，ING銀行目前拍賣的貸款規模約5億美元，借款方包括資料中心營運商CyrusOne(CONE-US) 、EdgeConnex及Vantage Data Centres，以及甲骨文在新墨西哥州支持的Project Jupiter。
其中，Project Jupiter目前因電力許可證審批延誤面臨進度問題，甲骨文已針對此事發出不可抗力通知。
法國興業銀行則尋求出售約3億美元的專案融資債務，涉及甲骨文在威斯康辛州的Project Lighthouse，以及德州的Project Frontier。
Project Jupiter、Project Lighthouse以及Project Frontier去年合計向數十家銀行籌集超過560億美元的建設債務。
貸款定價方面，威斯康辛州及德州項目的相關貸款報價仍高於面額90美分。知情人士表示，這波出售主要是投資組合管理操作，並非銀行急於避開信用品質惡化的資產。
相較之下，新墨西哥州項目的貸款預估成交價格約為面額85美分，顯示電力許可延誤已為該項目帶來額外不確定性。

AI融資曝險過度集中　銀行尋求降低風險

知情人士指出，銀行業對AI資料中心債務的疑慮已累積數月，主要問題在於金融機構對少數大型科技公司及尖端AI實驗室的曝險過度集中。
Nuveen全球能源基礎設施信貸主管Don Dimitrievich指出，AI基礎設施所需的資本規模，以任何標準衡量都已創下歷史紀錄，甚至超出傳統資金來源的承受能力。他表示，許多金融機構的風險長已明確要求縮減相關投資組合。
Dimitrievich也指出，近期貸款出售活動提供了較有利的融資條件與更具吸引力的報酬，原因包括部分貸款機構重新評估風險，以及監管資本限制。
律師事務所Linklaters紐約結構性融資合夥人David Lucking表示，銀行持有這類債務的資本效率較低，無論是資本要求、風險限額或內部資產負債表管理，都促使銀行尋找其他方式，以便在控制風險的同時繼續放貸。
除了直接出售貸款，銀行也開始透過信用保險及風險移轉交易管理曝險，並愈來愈常採用144A架構，讓債務能出售給更廣泛的機構投資人。
144A債券是依照美國《1933年證券法》第144A條發行的私募債券，允許發行人向合格機構投資人進行私募，不必經過美國證券交易委員會（SEC）繁複的公開註冊程序。
知情人士透露，Anthropic規模630億美元的債務融資方案，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 為購買AI晶片安排的400億美元融資，預計都將在未來幾個月進入144A債券市場交易。
值得注意的是，部分主要貸款機構已退出Anthropic的融資交易，原因正是擔憂對該AI實驗室的曝險過度集中，反映銀行業對AI相關融資的風險控管正在收緊。

保密條款增加避險難度　英歐監管機構同步調查

除了降低貸款曝險，銀行也面臨另一項風險管理難題。部分資料中心貸款合約設有保密條款，禁止貸款機構參與需要共享貸款資訊的第三方交易，包括信用違約交換（CDS）及合成風險移轉工具，使銀行難以透過一般衍生性金融商品對沖相關風險。
Lucking表示，如果這類限制在市場上愈來愈普遍，將為金融機構帶來相當大的問題。
與此同時，歐洲監管機構也正加強對資料中心融資的審查。知情人士透露，英國央行正向英國各銀行索取資料中心項目貸款的詳細資訊，作為例行監管工作的一部分。
歐洲央行則已啟動監管審查，評估歐元區銀行對資料中心融資的曝險程度及風險管理方式，相關計畫最早於10月底與銀行高層的會議中討論。
